punctuated:
成化五年進士登科錄

玉音

成化五年三月十一日，禮部尚書臣姚夔等於奉天門奏為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中二百四十七名。本年三月十五日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官：太子少保、吏部尚書兼文淵閣大學士等官彭時等四十九員。其進士出身，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
資善大夫、兵部尚書兼翰林院學士商輅〔乙丑進士〕
資善大夫、吏部尚書崔恭〔丙辰進士〕
資善大夫、戶部尚書楊鼎〔己未進士〕
translation_en:
Record of the Metropolitan Graduates of the Fifth Year of the Chenghua Era (成化五年進士登科錄)

Imperial Rescript (玉音)

On the eleventh day of the third month of the fifth year of the Chenghua era [April 22, 1469], Your Servant Yao Kui 姚夔, Minister of Rites, and others submitted a memorial at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven (Fengtianmen 奉天門) concerning the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from throughout the empire, two hundred and forty-seven candidates have been selected. For the Palace Examination on the fifteenth day of the third month of this year [April 26, 1469], it is fitting to request the appointment of Readers of the Examination Papers (Dujuanguan 讀卷官) and officiating officials: Peng Shi 彭時, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Profundity (Wenyuange 文淵閣), and other officials, numbering forty-nine in all. As for the status conferred upon the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), we respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by Emperor Gaozu, the Grand Progenitor (Taizu Gao Huangdi 太祖高皇帝): in the First Class (diyijia 第一甲), three candidates are regularly selected—the first-place candidate at rank 6b, and the second- and third-place candidates at rank 7a—who are granted the title "Metropolitan Graduate with Honors" (jinshi jidi 進士及第); those in the Second Class (dierjia 第二甲), at rank 7b, are granted the title "Metropolitan Graduate" (jinshi chushen 進士出身); and those in the Third Class (disanjia 第三甲), at rank 8a, are granted the title "Associate Metropolitan Graduate" (tong jinshi chushen 同進士出身). We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of the Examination Papers (讀卷官)
Shang Lu 商輅, Grand Master for Assisting toward Goodness, Minister of War, and Academician of the Hanlin Academy (a metropolitan graduate of the yichou year [1445]).
Cui Gong 崔恭, Grand Master for Assisting toward Goodness and Minister of Personnel (a metropolitan graduate of the bingchen year [1436]).
Yang Ding 楊鼎, Grand Master for Assisting toward Goodness and Minister of Revenue (a metropolitan graduate of the jiwei year [1439]).

三月十五日早，諸貢士赴內府殿試，上御奉天殿，親賜策問。

三月十七日早，文武百官朝服侍班。是日，錦衣衛設鹵簿于丹陛、丹墀內。上御奉天殿，鴻臚寺官傳制唱名。禮部官捧黃榜，鼓樂導引出長安左門外張掛畢，順天府官用傘蓋、儀從送狀元歸第。
translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors

Fifth Year of the Chenghua Reign (1469)

Early on the fifteenth day of the third month, the Tribute Scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination (dianshi). His Majesty took his seat in the Fengtian Hall and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early on the seventeenth day of the third month, the civil and military officials attended in court robes, standing in their ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard set out the imperial insignia and regalia upon the Cinnabar Steps and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. His Majesty took his seat in the Fengtian Hall, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names on the roll. Officials of the Ministry of Rites carried the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out through the Left Chang'an Gate to post it. Once it was hung, officials of Shuntian Prefecture used a ceremonial parasol and retinue to escort the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) back to his residence.

translation_en:
On the eighteenth day of the third month, a banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites. After the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.
On the nineteenth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) was bestowed court dress, a cap, and a belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).
On the twentieth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in presenting a memorial to express gratitude for Imperial grace.
On the twenty-first day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). The Ministry of Rites submitted a memorial requesting that the Ministry of Works be commanded to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education (Guozijian).

重慶下　兄擴〔冠帶總旗〕　弟搊　拭〔國子生〕　扶　操　娶張氏　繼娶孔氏
四川鄉試第四十一名　會試第一百八十一名
punctuated:
張習〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣民籍，儒士，治《易經》，字企翱，行一，年三十七，八月十二日生〕。曾祖貞吉，祖孟恭，父曉，初母沈氏，繼母王氏。永感下。娶顧氏。應天府鄉試第八十八名，會試第二十六名。

李秉衷〔貫直隸徐州豐縣人，應天府江寧縣官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字德夫，行一，年三十三，正月初四日生〕。曾祖愷〔縣主簿〕，祖文通〔贈南京欽天監副〕，父宗善〔南京欽天監副〕，母張氏〔封安人〕。嚴侍下。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第三十三名，會試第一百三十名。

舒春〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣人，武功中衛軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字景熈，行一，年四十，十一月十七日生〕。曾祖惠貮，祖志，父道輝，母陳氏。永感下。弟英、泰、泰晋、晟。娶袁氏。順天府鄉試第一百十三名，會試第二百三十九名。

陳揆〔貫四川重慶府合州銅梁縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字季同，行二，年二十九，閏十一月十二日生〕。曾祖志賢〔贈右副都御史〕，祖瑀〔封右副都御史〕，父价〔右副都御史〕，母馮氏〔封淑人〕。重慶下。兄擴〔冠帶總旗〕，弟捐、拭〔國子生〕、扶、操。娶張氏，繼娶孔氏。四川鄉試第四十一名，會試第一百八十一名。
translation_en:
Zhang Xi 張習 [native of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in a commoner household; Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Qi'ao, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhenji, his grandfather was Zhang Menggong, his father was Zhang Xiao, his first mother was née Shen, and his stepmother was née Wang. Both his parents are deceased. He married Lady Gu. He placed eighty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Bingzhong 李秉衷 [originally from Feng County, Xuzhou, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in an official household in Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture; National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Defu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the fourth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Li Kai [County Assistant Magistrate], his grandfather was Li Wentong [posthumously honored as Vice Director of the Nanjing Directorate of Astronomy], his father is Li Zongshan [Vice Director of the Nanjing Directorate of Astronomy], and his mother was née Zhang [invested as Master's Wife (Anren)]. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He married Lady Zhang. He placed thirty-third in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shu Chun 舒春 [originally from Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military household in the Wugong Central Guard; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingxi, first in seniority among brothers, aged forty, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shu Huier, his grandfather was Shu Zhi, his father was Shu Daohui, and his mother was née Chen. Both his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Shu Ying, Shu Tai, Shu Taijin [?], and Shu Sheng. He married Lady Yuan. He placed one hundred thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Kui 陳揆 [native of Tongliang County, Hezhou, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan, registered in an artisan household; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jitong, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the intercalary eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zhixian [posthumously honored as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief], his grandfather is Chen Yu [invested as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief], his father is Chen Jia [Right Vice Censor-in-Chief], and his mother is née Feng [invested as Lady of Virtue (Shuren)]. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Chen Kuo [Platoon Commander with Cap and Belt], and his younger brothers are Chen Juan, Chen Shi [National University Student], Chen Fu, and Chen Cao. He married Lady Zhang, and after her death married Lady Kong. He placed forty-first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

白玢〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字宗璞，行四，年四十，口月十三日生〕。曾祖均琔；祖守中；父希原；母錢氏。永感下。兄珙、玘、琬。娶髙氏。應天府鄉試第三十八名，會試第一百七十九名。
鄭宏〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字元之，行四，年四十，二月十五日生〕。曾祖德名；祖章可；父厚一；母王氏。慈侍下。兄洪、澄、湧；弟淦、海。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第一名，會試第七名。
樂宣〔貫湖廣永州府道州寧遠縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字繼諧，行二，年二十九，九月二十四日生〕。曾祖仕源；祖逢清；父韶〔教諭〕；嫡母李氏，生母李氏。具慶下。兄武〔運塩使司判官〕；弟成、琳、瓉、璿。娶李氏。湖廣鄉試第四十八名，會試第二百十七名。
蕭璵〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣儒籍，國子生，治《書經》，字煥如，行一，年三十一，六月十八日生〕。曾祖仲齡；祖引之〔封左通政〕；父齜〔左通政〕；母李氏〔封宜人〕。重慶下。弟珂〔貢士〕、玠、瓚、珣、璲。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第十名，會試第十七名。
translation_en:
Bai Bin 白玢 [registered under civilian household status in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili); a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongpu; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the thirteenth day of the [?] month]. His great-grandfather was Bai Jundian; his grandfather was Bai Shouzhong; his father was Bai Xiyuan; and his mother was née Qian. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Bai Gong, Bai Qi, and Bai Wan; he married née Gao. He ranked 38th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 179th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Hong 鄭宏 [registered under civilian household status in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanzhi; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the fifteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Deming; his grandfather was Zheng Zhangke; his father was Zheng Houyi; and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zheng Hong, Zheng Cheng, and Zheng Yong; his younger brothers are Zheng Gan and Zheng Hai; and he married née Wang. He ranked 1st in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 7th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yue Xuan 樂宣 [registered under civilian household status in Ningyuan County, Daozhou Subprefecture, Yongzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jixie; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yue Shiyuan; his grandfather was Yue Fengqing; his father is Yue Shao [Instructor]; his legal mother is née Li, and his birth mother is née Li. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Yue Wu [Administrative Assistant of a Salt Distribution Commission]; his younger brothers are Yue Cheng, Yue Lin, Yue Zan, and Yue Xuan; and he married née Li. He ranked 48th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 217th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Yu 蕭璵 [registered under Confucian scholar household status in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Huanru; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiao Zhongling; his grandfather is Xiao Yinzhi [invested with the title of Left Transmission Commissioner]; his father is Xiao Zi [Left Transmission Commissioner]; and his mother is née Li [invested as Lady of Suitability]. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xiao Ke [Tribute Scholar (gongshi)], Xiao Jie, Xiao Zan, Xiao Xun, and Xiao Sui; he married née Liu. He ranked 10th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 17th in the Metropolitan Examination.

言芳〔貫山東濟南府鄒平縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字宗本，行六，年三十三，四月二十七日生〕。曾祖子秀，祖進〔光祿寺署丞〕，父賓，母高氏，繼母霍氏。具慶下。兄宗仁、宗政、宗智、宗輔、宗敏。娶孫氏。山東鄉試第二十二名，會試第一百五十一名。

translation_en:
Liang Ze 梁澤 (registered under military household status in Sanyuan County, Yaozhou, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a county student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Rulin; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Liang Yunzhong, his grandfather was Liang Jingyuan, his father was Liang Qi, and his mother is née Meng. His mother is living. His elder brother is Liang Liang, and his younger brothers are Liang Han, Liang Chun, and Liang Shan. He is unmarried. He ranked first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ying 王纓 (registered under civilian household status in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a county student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Yongqing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yanzong, his grandfather was Wang Mengchang, and his father was Wang Mao (Instructor); his father's former wife was née Xuan, his mother was née Shen, and his stepmother is née Wan. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Wang Yi, and his younger brothers are Wang Yue, Wang Ji, and Wang Hui. He married née Tang. He ranked one hundred twenty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Fang 言芳 (registered under military household status in Zouping County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Zongben; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Zixiu, his grandfather was Yan Jin (Assistant Office Director in the Court of Imperial Entertainments), his father is Yan Bin, his mother was née Gao, and his stepmother is née Huo. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Yan Zongren, Yan Zongzheng, Yan Zongzhi, Yan Zongfu, and Yan Zongmin. He married née Sun. He ranked twenty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yan 李延 (registered under military household status in Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a prefectural student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Yuling; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the fourth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Li Zonghai, his grandfather was Li Nanpo, his father is Li Shizong, and his mother is née Zhang. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Lan, Li Hui, Li Jing, Li Hua, Li Xuan, and Li Chang, and his younger brother is Li Man. He married née Xu. He ranked seventy-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Rui 王瑞 [registered in a physician household of Wangjiang County 望江縣, Anqing Prefecture 安慶府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); Directorate Student (guozisheng 國子生); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Liangbi 良璧; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Huaqing 王華卿; his grandfather was Wang Wei 王偉; his father is Wang Jing 王景; his mother was née Dong 東氏, and his stepmothers were née Li 李氏 and née Liu 劉氏. Both parents are living (with his father and stepmother). His elder brothers are Wang Li 王理, Wang Qiong 王瓊, and Wang Xi 王璽; his younger brothers are Wang Lian 王璉, Wang Lin 王琳, Wang Qi 王琦, Wang Ying 王瑛, Wang Gui 王珪, Wang Cong 王璁, and Wang Lang 王琅. He married née Wu 吳氏, and remarried née Xiao 蕭氏. He placed seventy-first in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Zhongshi 閻仲實 [registered in a military household of Long Subprefecture 隴州, Fengxiang Prefecture 鳳翔府, Shaanxi 陝西; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Guangfu 光甫; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Caishun 閻才順; his grandfather was Yan Xiu 閻秀; his father was Yan Xuan 閻璿 [Instructor (jiaoyu 教諭)]; his mother was née Wang 王氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Yan Zhongkuan 閻仲寬; his younger brothers are Yan Zhongyu 閻仲宇, Yan Zhongrong 閻仲容, Yan Zhongyin 閻仲寅, Yan Zhongbin 閻仲賓, Yan Zhonghong 閻仲宏, and Yan Zhongning 閻仲寧. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Long 尹龍 [registered in a civilian household of Licheng County 歷城縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Shunchen 舜臣; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-two, born on the second day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Yin Deming 尹得名 [posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Personnel (libu you shilang 吏部右侍郎)]; his grandfather was Yin Hong 尹宏 [Prefect (zhifu 知府), posthumously honored as Left Vice Minister of Personnel (libu zuo shilang 吏部左侍郎)]; his father is Yin Min 尹旻 [Left Vice Minister of Personnel]; his mother is née Zhang 張氏 [invested as Lady of Virtue (shuren 淑人)]. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yin Luan 尹鑾. He married née Yang 楊氏. He placed second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shang Jiong 尚絅 [registered in a military household of Suiyang Guard 睢陽衛, Henan 河南; Directorate Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji 禮記); courtesy name Meizhong 美中; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Shang Yun 尚雲; his grandfather is Shang Xing 尚興; his father is Shang Fu 尚福; his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His younger brother is Shang Jin 尚縉. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

郝志義〔貫陝西延安府綏德州清澗縣，軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字宜之，行二，年二十六，十一月初九日生〕。曾祖四；祖貞；父安〔知州〕；母楊氏。重慶下。兄志仁，弟志禮、志智、志信。娶白氏。陝西鄉試第十一名，會試第一百九十八名。

鄒儒〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣，竈籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字宗道，行一，年三十四，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖貴名；祖世勤；父儀；母俞氏。慈侍下。兄傑、俛，弟儼。娶孫氏。浙江鄉試第四十一名，會試第五十六名。

馮蘭〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣，民籍，儒士，治《禮記》，字佩之，行二，年二十七，十月十八日生〕。曾祖本清〔按察司僉事〕；祖綸；父憲；母何氏。重慶下。弟萱、蓀、蓁。娶陸氏。浙江鄉試第八名，會試第一百二十五名。
translation_en:
Gong Ze 龔澤 [registered in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household registration; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiji 時濟; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Gong Meng 蒙 [posthumously granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Works]; his grandfather was Gong Bi 璧 [Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Works]; his father is Gong Kan 衎; his father's principal wives were Lady Wang 王氏 and successive wives Lady Luo 羅氏, Lady Zheng 鄭氏, and Lady Ye 葉氏; his birth mother is Lady Ying 應氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Gong Pu 溥, and his younger brothers are Gong Chao 潮 [tribute student (gongshi)], Gong Han 瀚, and Gong Yuan 源. He married Lady Gui 桂氏. He placed ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hao Zhiyi 郝志義 [registered in Qingjian County, Suide Subprefecture, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, under military household registration; an Added Student of the County School (xianxue zengguang sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yizhi 宜之; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Hao Si 四; his grandfather is Hao Zhen 貞; his father is Hao An 安 [Subprefectural Magistrate]; his mother is Lady Yang 楊氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Hao Zhiren 志仁, and his younger brothers are Hao Zhili 志禮, Hao Zhizhi 志智, and Hao Zhixin 志信. He married Lady Bai 白氏. He placed eleventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Ru 鄒儒 [registered in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under saltern household registration; a County School Student (xianxue sheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongdao 宗道; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zou Guiming 貴名; his grandfather was Zou Shiqin 世勤; his father was Zou Yi 儀; his mother is Lady Yu 俞氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers (or cousins) are Zou Jie 傑 and Zou Mian 俛, and his younger brother is Zou Yan 儼. He married Lady Sun 孫氏. He placed forty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Lan 馮蘭 [registered in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household registration; a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Peizhi 佩之; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Benqing 本清 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his grandfather is Feng Lun 綸; his father is Feng Xian 憲; his mother is Lady He 何氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Feng Xuan 萱, Feng Sun 蓀, and Feng Zhen 蓁. He married Lady Lu 陸氏. He placed eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Both parents are living; he has a younger brother Xuan, and is married to a woman née Shen. He placed ninety-fifth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Xiang 郁庠 [registered in a civilian household in Jingzhou, Hejian Prefecture, Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Congzhou; first in seniority among his brothers; thirty sui, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month]. His mother is living; he has younger brothers Qing, Lian, Guang, Kang, Tang, Ting, Fu, and Zuo, and is married to a woman née Du. He placed sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Bian 徐昪 [registered in a military household in Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yizhi; first in seniority among his brothers; forty sui, born on the twenty-first day of the fifth month]. Wu Cheng 吳珵 [originally from Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, registered in an artisan household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanyu; first in seniority among his brothers; thirty-five sui, born on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month]. His mother is living; he has a younger brother Xi, married a woman née Xu, and subsequently married women née Li and née Shen. He placed twenty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hui 李蕙 [registered in Dangtu County 當塗縣, Taiping Prefecture 太平府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, under a civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dexin 德馨, third in seniority among brothers, age thirty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Xin 信; his grandfather was Li Shun 順 [Secretary in the Ministry of Justice]; his father was Li Xiang 翔; his mother is née Jiang 蔣. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Fan 蕃 and Li Yun 芸; his younger brothers are Li Hua 華 and Li Ying 英. He married née Chen 陳. He placed fifty-third in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Chen 張忱 [registered in Changli County 昌黎縣, Yongping Prefecture 永平府, Northern Metropolitan Area 直隸, under a civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Boxun 伯恂, first in seniority among brothers, age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Guang 廣 [posthumously granted the title of Transmission Commissioner]; his grandfather was Zhang Jian 鑑 [posthumously granted the title of Transmission Commissioner]; his father is Zhang Wenzhi 文質 [Left Vice Minister of War]; his late mother was née Wang 王 [posthumously granted the title of Lady of Virtue]; his stepmother is née Liu 劉 [invested as Lady of Virtue]. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Zao 慥 and Zhang Huai 懷 [student of the Directorate of Education]. He married née Bian 卞. He placed seventy-second in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Songling 毛松齡 [registered in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西, under a military household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Qiaonian 喬年, third in seniority among brothers, age twenty-six, born on the seventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Mao Yanren 彥仁; his grandfather was Mao Rongzhi 容止; his father is Mao Xian 顯 [Assistant Instructor]; his mother is née Wang 王. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Mao Chunling 椿齡 and Mao Zhangling 樟齡; his younger brothers are Mao Guiling 桂齡, Mao Qiling 杞齡, Mao Nanling 楠齡, Mao Bailing 栢齡, Mao Guiling 檜齡, and Mao Chouling 椆齡. He married née Jiang 姜. He placed thirty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Lin 黃麟 [registered in Mi County 密縣, Jun Subprefecture 鈞州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, under a civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenxiang 文祥, second in seniority among brothers, age thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Wenzhong 文中 [Prefect]; his grandfather is Huang Deheng 德恒; his father is Huang Kai 愷 [Instructor]; his mother is née Yan 閻. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Huang Qi 麒; his younger brothers are Huang Yuan 鵷, Huang Feng 鳳, Huang Ji 驥, and Huang Xiang 驤. He married née Hu 胡. He placed seventeenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

楊遵〔貫湖廣衡州府衡山縣人，貴州平越衛官籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字循德，行二，年三十四，十月十七日生〕。曾祖廣四郎；祖必富；父中；母李氏。嚴侍下。兄遵安〔百戶〕，弟逵、遇。娶孟氏。雲南鄉試第十九名，會試第五十一名。
冀綺〔貫直隸揚州府高郵州寶應縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字文華，行一，年三十三，九月二十四日生〕。曾祖汝能〔府同知〕；祖覯；父良；嫡母王氏、楊氏，生母顧氏，繼母袁氏。永感下。兄綗、綸、綱，弟縯、綰、約、綝。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第三十八名，會試第六十二名。
張禎叔〔貫四川重慶府巴縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字禎叔，行一，年二十九，閏十一月十九日生〕。曾祖英；祖文聰〔贈按察司僉事〕；父靖〔左布政使〕；母龍氏〔贈宜人〕，繼母龔氏〔封宜人〕。重慶下。弟祥叔、祺叔、禧叔、盛叔、磐叔。娶胡氏。四川鄉試第二十七名，會試第二百三十三名。
translation_en:
Xu Yuxian 徐與憲 [registered as a commoner in Guangshan County, Guang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Wenzhen; third in seniority among brothers; aged forty-two; born on the ninth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Daoheng; his grandfather was Xu Yide; his father was Xu Tong; and his mother was née Wang. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Yukang and Yuqing; his younger brother is Yuzhe. He married née You. He placed forty-fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Zun 楊遵 [native of Hengshan County, Hengzhou Prefecture, Huguang, registered in an official household in Pingyue Guard, Guizhou; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xunde; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four; born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Guangsilang; his grandfather was Yang Bifu; his father is Yang Zhong; and his mother was née Li. His father is living (yanshixia). His elder brother is Zun'an [Company Commander (baihu)], and his younger brothers are Kui and Yu. He married née Meng. He placed nineteenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ji Qi 冀綺 [registered as a commoner in Baoying County, Gaoyou Subprefecture, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenhua; first in seniority; aged thirty-three; born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Ji Runeng [Prefectural Vice Prefect (fu tongzhi)]; his grandfather was Ji Gou; his father was Ji Liang; his legal mothers were née Wang and née Yang, his birth mother was née Gu, and his stepmother was née Yuan. Both parents are deceased (yongganxia). His elder brothers are Jiong, Lun, and Gang; his younger brothers are Yan, Wan, Yue, and Chen. He married née Wang. He placed thirty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zhenshu 張禎叔 [registered as a commoner in Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhenshu; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the nineteenth day of the intercalary eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Ying; his grandfather is Zhang Wencong [posthumously/honorifically titled Assistant Surveillance Commissioner (anchasi qianshi)]; his father is Zhang Jing [Left Administration Commissioner (zuo buzhengshi)]; his mother was née Long [posthumously titled Lady of Suitability (yiren)], and his stepmother is née Gong [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. Both parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). His younger brothers are Xiangshu, Qishu, Xishu, Shengshu, and Panshu. He married née Hu. He placed twenty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

周瑛〔貫福建鎮海衛人，興化府莆田縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字梁石，行一，年四十，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖正甫；祖世；父舉；母潘氏。慈侍下。弟環、頊。娶陳氏，繼娶吳氏。福建鄉試第六名，會試第七十八名。

張錦〔貫河南開封府太康縣，陝西岷州衛軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字尚絅，行四，年三十，正月十三日生〕。曾祖興；祖文信；父善；母趙氏。嚴侍下。兄銘、琮、銳，弟鐸、鏞、綸。娶劉氏。陝西鄉試第三十七名，會試第二十三名。

蔡晟〔貫河南開封府雎州軍籍，州學生，治《禮記》，字文輝，行五，年二十四，二月二十八日生〕。曾祖大翁；祖青；父敬；前母呂氏、王氏，母張氏。具慶下。兄貴、全、亮、通〔聽選官〕。娶胡氏。河南鄉試第六十九名，會試第一百五名。
translation_en:
Shen Rui 沈銳 (native of Renhe County 仁和縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江, of commoner registration; a county student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Wenjin 文進; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Derong 德榮; his grandfather was Shen Dingzhi 定之; his father is Shen Zhen 珎; and his mother is née Pan 潘氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Shen Zhen 震, and his younger brothers are Shen Jian 鑑 and Shen Ming 銘. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed seventy-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Ying 周瑛 (native of Zhenhai Guard 鎮海衛, Fujian 福建, of military registration in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Liangshi 梁石; first in seniority among his brothers; age forty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhengfu 正甫; his grandfather was Zhou Shi 世; his father was Zhou Ju 舉; and his mother is née Pan 潘氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Zhou Huan 環 and Zhou Xu 頊. He married née Chen 陳氏, and remarried née Wu 吳氏. He placed sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jin 張錦 (native of Taikang County 太康縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, of military registration in Minzhou Guard 岷州衛, Shaanxi 陝西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing 書經]; courtesy name Shangjiong 尚絅; fourth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty, born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Xing 興; his grandfather was Zhang Wenxin 文信; his father is Zhang Shan 善; and his mother was née Zhao 趙氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Ming 銘, Zhang Cong 琮, and Zhang Rui 銳, and his younger brothers are Zhang Duo 鐸, Zhang Yong 鏞, and Zhang Lun 綸. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed thirty-seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Sheng 蔡晟 (native of Juzhou 雎州 [Suizhou 睢州], Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, of military registration; a subprefectural student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji 禮記]; courtesy name Wenhui 文輝; fifth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Cai Daweng 大翁; his grandfather was Cai Qing 青; his father is Cai Jing 敬; his father's former wives were née Lü 呂氏 and née Wang 王氏, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Cai Gui 貴, Cai Quan 全, Cai Liang 亮, and Cai Tong 通 (Expectant Official). He married née Hu 胡氏. He placed sixty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Jin 張縉 (registered under a commoner household in Yangqu County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Chaoyong; first among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the third day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhonghe, his grandfather was Zhang Shouyi, his father was Zhang Neng, and his mother is née Yang. His mother is living (cishixia); his younger brothers are Zhang Shen, Zhang Jing, Zhang Lun, and Zhang Fu; he is married to née Gao. He placed twenty-sixth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Mengzhong 周孟中 (registered under a commoner household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shike; first among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhongliang, his grandfather was Zhou Zixun, his father was Zhou Xun (County Director of Studies), and his mother is née Peng. His mother is living (cishixia); he is married to née Liu. He placed eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Shen 朱紳 (a native of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, registered under a military artisan household of the Embroidered Uniform Guard; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Yizhong; second among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Shiying, his grandfather is Zhu Benshan, his father is Zhu Mengxian, and his mother is née Huang. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia); his elder brother is Zhu Jin, and his younger brothers are Zhu Jing, Zhu Lun, and Zhu Zu; he is married to née Wang. He placed fiftieth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Bin 解賓 (registered under a commoner household in Gaoyang County, Anzhou, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shangjing; first among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Yuan, his grandfather was Xie Kuan, his father is Xie Hai, and his mother is née Su. Both his parents are living (juqingxia); his younger brother is Xie Xuan (Public-spirited Official); he is married to née Zhang. He placed forty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Hou Fang 侯方 (registered in a commoner household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Gongju; second in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the seventh day of the intercalary seventh month). His great-grandfather was Kezhao, his grandfather was Tingxin, his father is Jin (Vice Prefect), and his mother is née Shen. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Zheng, and his younger brothers are Hong, Ping, Mei, Zhen, and Xian. He married née Zhou. He placed 84th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 71st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yuanzhen 李元鎮 (registered in a saltern household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yuanzhen; second in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Long (District Magistrate), his grandfather was Yangtong, his father is Ti, and his mother is née Lin. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Qian, and his younger brothers are Dai and Yan. He married née Wu. He placed 74th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Xiang 趙祥 (registered in a military household of Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Prefectural School Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Menglin; first in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the thirtieth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Cheng, his grandfather was Qi, his father was Quan, his mother was née Zhou, and his stepmother is née Gao. His mother [stepmother] is living; his younger brother is Zhen. He married née Yu. He placed 102nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Jing 熊景 (registered in a commoner household of Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Kaifu; second in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Derang (Commissioner-in-chief of a Commercial Tax Office), his grandfather was Sujing, his father is Zizhi, and his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Hui, Hao, and Zhao. He married née Fu. He placed 74th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 170th in the Metropolitan Examination.

方守〔貫福建興化府莆田縣鹽籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字宜約，行五，年三十四，六月初六日生〕。曾祖積善；祖夢周；父休徵，母王氏。嚴侍下。兄賢、聰、貞、誌，弟宰、寬。娶蔡氏。福建鄉試第五十五名，會試第六十七名。

王鼎〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元勳，行一，年三十二，十一月初五日生〕。曾祖佐；祖衡；父綱，母徐氏。重慶下。弟彝、冠、冕、卣、斝、旒。娶薛氏。應天府鄉試第一百二十八名，會試第一百四十二名。
translation_en:
Lu Kui 陸奎 [registered in a civilian household of Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenyao 文曜; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Yi 義; his grandfather was Lu Jiang 江; his father is Lu Ji 稷, and his mother is Lady Shao 邵氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Lu Hou 垕, Lu Tang 堂, and Lu Jian 堅. He is married to Lady Xu 徐氏. He ranked 14th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 163rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Zhong 郭忠 [registered in a civilian household of Feixiang County, Guangping Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingchen 廷臣; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Guo Renmei 仁美; his grandfather was Guo Sheng 晟 [Guard Registrar]; his father is Guo Qian 謙 [Vice Magistrate], and his mother was Lady Shi 石氏. His father is living. His younger brothers are Guo Shu 恕, Guo Mao 懋, Guo Fen 忿, Guo Hui 慧, and Guo Xian 憲. He is married to Lady Liang 梁氏. He ranked 7th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 69th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Shou 方守 [registered in a saltern household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yiyue 宜約; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Jishan 積善; his grandfather was Fang Mengzhou 夢周; his father is Fang Xiuzheng 休徵, and his mother was Lady Wang 王氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Fang Xian 賢, Fang Cong 聰, Fang Zhen 貞, and Fang Zhi 誌, and his younger brothers are Fang Zai 宰 and Fang Kuan 寬. He is married to Lady Cai 蔡氏. He ranked 55th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 67th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ding 王鼎 [registered in a military household of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanxun 元勳; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fifth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zuo 佐; his grandfather is Wang Heng 衡; his father is Wang Gang 綱, and his mother is Lady Xu 徐氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Yi 彝, Wang Guan 冠, Wang Mian 冕, Wang You 卣, Wang Jia 斝, and Wang Liu 旒. He is married to Lady Xue 薛氏. He ranked 128th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 142nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Ji 陳紀 [registered as of civilian status in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Confucian Scholar (rushi); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shuzhen; third in generational order; age twenty-three, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zijing, his grandfather was Wenzhi, his father is Keng, his primary mother is née Zhang, and his birth mother is née Liu. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Gu and Chang [Assistant Instructor], and his younger brother is Shen. He married née Pan. He placed forty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Sheng 張晟 [registered as of civilian status in Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Mengyang; first in generational order; age thirty-two, born on the third day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Fu, his grandfather was Yong, his father was Bin, and his mother is née Cao. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Sheng, Ang, and Min. He married née Yu. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Zan 胡贊 [a native of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in the Xingzhou Central Farming-Garrison Guard; Military Student of the Liangxiang County School; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Kexiang; twenty-second in generational order; age twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Simin, his grandfather was Runchu, his father is Kuan [invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice], his deceased mother was née Zheng [posthumously honored as Lady of Serenity], and his stepmother is née Wang. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Ming, Hong, Gong [Secretary in the Ministry of Justice], Yan, Lun, and Quan [Granary Vice Commissioner]. He married née Huang. He placed fifteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Xi 靳璽 [registered as of military status in Cao County, Cao Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; County School Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Jingyu; second in generational order; age twenty-nine, born on the second day of the intercalary eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Hongyi, his grandfather was Haoxian, his father was Shimin [County Assistant Magistrate], his father's former wife was née Wang, and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living. His elder brother is Ying. He married née Zhao. He placed thirty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Gong 謝恭 (registered under civilian household status in Xiuning County 休寧縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Directly Attached Territory [Zhili 直隸]; a National University Student [Guozisheng] specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Wen'an 文安; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Shixiang 仕祥; his grandfather was Xie Dechen 德琛; his father is Xie Gongzhen 功振; and his mother is née Jin 金氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Xie Min 敏 and Xie En 恩. He is married to a woman née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 10th in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and 79th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jie 李介 (registered under military household status in Gaomi County 高密縣, Jiaozhou Subprefecture 膠州, Laizhou Prefecture 萊州府, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Shouzheng 守貞; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month). Wang Chen 王臣 (registered under official household status in Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Shishang 世賞; second in seniority among his brothers; aged sixteen, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Zishan 子善 (posthumously honored as Surveillance Commissioner [Ancha shi]); his grandfather was Wang Zhongqi 仲起 (enfeoffed as Surveillance Commissioner); his father is Wang Gai 槩 (Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review [Dali si qing]); his legal mother is née Liu 劉氏 (enfeoffed as Lady of Virtue [Shuren]); and his birth mother is née Qi 齊氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Shixuan 世瓛; his younger brothers are Wang Shiyan 世延, Wang Shixuan 世選, Wang Shiyong 世用, and Wang Shiqing 世卿. He is betrothed to a woman née Jiang 蔣氏. He placed 33rd in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 208th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Mian 陳勉 (registered under civilian household status in Linchuan County 臨川縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zimian 自勉; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the first day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Chen Jiujiang 九江; his grandfather was Chen Kongli 孔立; his father is Chen Yanchi 彥持; and his mother is née Li 李氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Zimu 自牧, Chen Ziju 自居, Chen Ziye 自謁, and Chen Ziduan 自端; his younger brothers are Chen Ziyue 自說 and Chen Zihui 自輝. He is married to a woman née Liang 梁氏. He placed 59th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 92nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao Gui 邵珪 (registered in a military household in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Zhili 直隸; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenjing 文敬; seventh in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the ninth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Shanglin 商霖; his grandfather was Wenmu 文穆; his father is Fang 昉; and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Jing 璟, Li 理, Zhen 珎, and Can 璨; his younger brother is Zhang 璋. He is married to née Gong 龔氏. translation_en:
Yang Dun 楊惇 (registered in a civilian household of Lu'an Subprefecture, Luzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zaifu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-second day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yang Gui; his grandfather was Yang Sheng (Subprefectural Magistrate); his father is Yang Zuo, and his mother is née Pei. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yang Bian (District Magistrate); his younger brothers are Yang Heng, Yang Xun, Yang Bo, Yang Kai, Yang Ti, Yang Huai, Yang Yue, and Yang Hui. He married née Zhang. He placed 77th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 230th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Lian 李璉 (registered in a civilian household of Huaining District, Anqing Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Chunfu; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fifth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Li Zhike; his grandfather was Li Liang (Director of the Palace Medical Office); his father was Li Sheng (Principal Practitioner of the Medical School), his father's former wives were née Zhu and née Xu, and his mother is née Yan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Zan, Li Cong, Li Zhen, Li Jing, and Li Ying; his younger brothers are Li Jian and Li Xiu. He married née Xu, and subsequently married née Geng. He placed 44th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 33rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhongqi 劉忠器 (registered in a civilian household of Xinchang District, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Confucian scholar [unranked student]; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Shiyong; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Zongyuan; his grandfather was Liu Rugeng; his father is Liu Yonghua, and his mother is née Dong. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Yunqi, Liu Shunqi, and Liu Daqi. He married née Ye. He placed 19th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 226th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Zhong 楊重 (registered in a civilian household of Lingtai District, Jingzhou Subprefecture, Pingliang Prefecture, Shaanxi; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zhifu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Shi; his grandfather was Yang Yan (Commissioner-in-chief of a Livestock Service); his father is Yang Qing (District Magistrate), and his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Yang Xing, Yang Zhong, Yang Jian, and Yang Jing. He married née Mao. He placed 9th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 111th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Song Jing 宋經 [registered in a civilian household of Yuzhou 蔚州, Datong Prefecture 大同府, Shanxi 山西; a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dajing 大經; first in generational seniority; age twenty-five, born on the fourth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Song Wenyou 文友; his grandfather was Song Yu 玉 [posthumously honored as Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father is Song Bi 弼 [Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue]; his mother was née Qi 齊氏 [posthumously honored as Lady of Peace (Anren)]. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Song Lun 綸 [Public-spirited Official (Yiguan)] and Song Wan 綰. He married née Ma 馬氏. He placed twenty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yao 陳耀 [registered in a civilian household of Longxi County 龍溪縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian 福建; a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Kongzhang 孔彰; second in generational seniority; age forty, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Hongfu 弘甫; his grandfather was Chen Zide 子德; his father was Chen Mengyi 孟儀; his mother is née Li 李氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brother is Chen Xiegong 協恭, and his younger brothers are Chen Kongji 孔濟 and Chen Kongshen 孔慎. He married née Gao 高氏. He placed twenty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Fu 劉福 [registered in a military household of Ba County 巴縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川; a County Student (Xianxuesheng), specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tianyou 天祐; first in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Zhong 忠; his grandfather is Liu Wenfu 文富; his father is Liu Yongning 永寧; his mother is née Zhou 周氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Liu Hao 浩, Liu Kuan 寬, Liu Shou 壽, Liu Yu 裕, and Liu Lu 祿. He married née She 佘氏. He placed sixteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Shunbin 何舜賓 [registered in a civilian household of Xiaoshan County 蕭山縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; an Added County Student (Zengguangsheng), specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Muzhi 穆之; first in generational seniority; age forty, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was He Lisi 禮四; his grandfather was He Shanheng 善亨; his father was He Bi 璧; his mother is née Zhang 張氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His younger brother is He Shunqing 舜卿. He married née Zheng 鄭氏, and remarried to née Zhu 朱氏. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:

His great-grandfather was Zhu Baosan, his grandfather was Zhu Zizhuang, and his father was Zhu Derong; his father's former wife was née Chen, his mother was née Lin, and his stepmother was née Zhang. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Jue, Zhen, Yu, Qi, Zan, and Ying; he married née Weng. He placed 41st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 108th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zang Qiong 臧瓊 (registered in a civilian household of Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenrui; seniority third; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zang Ziyuan, his grandfather was Zang Zhonghe, and his father was Zang Sicong (Honorary Official); his mother was née Wang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Hai and Huan, and his younger brother is Ying; he married née Wang. He placed 78th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 167th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Lun 李崙 (registered in a civilian household of Lintong County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Shizhan; seniority third; aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Li Shu, his grandfather was Li Sizhong, and his father was Li Hai; his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmother was née Peng. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Yan and Yin; he is not yet betrothed. He placed 12th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 165th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ting 王廷 (registered in a salt-producer household of Puzhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Chaoyong; seniority second; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Xin, his grandfather was Wang Xiang, and his father was Wang Xiu; his father's former wives were née Zhang and née Yao, and his mother was née Ru. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Duo, and his younger brother is Yue; he married née Qu. He placed 60th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 249th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xie Gang 謝綱 (native of Baling County, Yuezhou Prefecture, Huguang, of military household registration; a county school student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhenlun, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Xie Siming, his grandfather Xie Biqing, his father Xie Wende, and his mother née Wu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xie Wei and Xie Shou; he is married to née Wang. He placed fifty-ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Qing 堯卿 (native of Anyue County, Tongchuan Subprefecture, Sichuan, of civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingfu, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Shenglong, his grandfather Yao Chen, his father Yao Congdao, his mother née Liu, and his stepmother née Wang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Yao Benzhong, and his younger brother is Yao Benjing; he is married to née Ding. He placed sixty-fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bao Qian 包謙 (native of Qiantang County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, of military household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yizhi, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Bao Tai, his grandfather Bao Run, his father Bao Chun, and his mother née Chen. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Bao Cheng and Bao Xu, and his younger brothers are Bao Liang and Bao Jin; he is married to née Zheng. He placed tenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhuang Gong 莊恭 (native of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of military household registration; a prefectural school student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yifu, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhuang Yugui, his grandfather Zhuang Yunxiang, his father Zhuang Jingyang, and his mother née Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhuang Congming, Zhuang Cong, Zhuang Rui, Zhuang Kuan, Zhuang Xin, Zhuang Min, Zhuang Hui, Zhuang Mu, and Zhuang Kui; he is married to née Cai. He placed twenty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Lu Heng 陸珩 [originally from Gui'an County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a civilian household in Fucheng County, Northern Metropolitan Area; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yongjie; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the sixth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Zizhen; his grandfather was Lu Bin [enfeoffed as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his father was Lu Ju [Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief]; and his mother is née Wang [enfeoffed as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Lu Fan, Lu Xuan [Company Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard], Lu Ke, Lu Yu, and Lu Cheng; his younger brothers are Lu Jia, Lu Chen [Houseman with Cap and Belt], and Lu Zhang. He married née Yan. He placed 81st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 171st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Jue 金爵 [originally from Mianzhou, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, registered in a military household of the Lizhou Guard; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Lianggui; first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Jin Heng; his grandfather was Jin Tianze; his father was Jin You; and his mother is née Lin. His mother is living. He married née Zhou. He placed 6th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 14th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xun 王珣 [registered in a civilian household in Cao County, Caozhou, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Derun; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Qi [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his grandfather was Wang Dao; his father is Wang Lan [Police Chief]; and his mother was née Gao. His father is living (yanshixia). His elder brothers are Wang Lian and Wang Qi [student of the Directorate of Education]; his younger brother is Wang Min. He married née Li. He placed 24th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Chun 張純 [registered in a military household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shihe; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang De; his grandfather was Zhang Cong [posthumously honored as Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his father was Zhang Yu [tribute student (gongshi)]; and his mother is née Pan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Gang, Zhang Ji [Instructor], and Zhang Ji; his younger brothers are Zhang Lun, Zhang Xu, Zhang Ji, and Zhang Shao. He married née Wang. He placed 75th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 207th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Lin Guiming 貴銘; his grandfather was Lin [2 characters illegible]; his father was Lin Ji 濟; his mother was née Xie 謝氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Lin [1 character illegible] (Tribute Student [gongshi]); his younger brother is Lin Zhen 珍. He married née Chen 陳氏. He ranked fourth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao You 邵猷 (native of Chun'an County 淳安縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江, of artisan household registration; a County Student [xianxuesheng] who specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals, courtesy name Chenzhi 陳之, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shao Fu 富; his grandfather was Shao Yu 郁; his father was Shao Kai 楷; his mother was née Xu 徐氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Shao Mo 謨; his younger brothers are Shao Gong 鞏, Shao Xin 新, and Shao Ji 機. He married née Fang 方氏. He ranked forty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zheng 汪正 (native of She County 歙縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸], of civilian household registration; a National University Student [guozisheng] who specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals, courtesy name Weizhong 惟中, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Shixian 仕賢; his grandfather was Wang Yongyi 永義; his father was Wang Yicong 以聰; his mother was née Wu 吳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Wang Biao 表. He married née Fang 方氏. His great-grandfather was Han Yanda 韓彥達; his grandfather was Han Liangke 韓良可 [District Jailor]; his father is Han Bi 韓弼 [Administrator of a Princely Establishment]; his mother was née Qu 璩氏, and his stepmother is née Wang 王氏. 李茂〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣人，順天府大興縣官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字世榮，行三，年三十九，十月十五日生〕。曾祖文林〔長史〕；祖立武〔序班〕；父玉；母曾氏。嚴侍下。兄源、榮，弟景華〔中書舍人〕、英、蕙、蘭。娶郭氏。順天府鄉試第一百二名，會試第二十七名。

張和〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字宗禮，行二，生年四十五，二月初九日生〕。曾祖得中〔元知縣〕；祖仲理；父鵬輝；母孫氏。永感下。兄种。娶孫氏，繼娶侃氏。順天府鄉試第七名，會試第六十五名。

陳雲鳳〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，儒士，治《易經》，字儀之，行二十，年二十九，八月初四日生〕。曾祖履初〔縣丞〕；祖魯賓；父曰籧；母段氏。嚴侍下。兄雲鵬〔布政使〕、雲龍、雲鶚〔知府〕。娶黃氏。浙江鄉試第二十九名，會試第一百四十三名。
translation_en:
Song Ji 宋驥 is registered in a civilian household of Shucheng County, Luzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Metropolitan Area]. An Added Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Deyuan, he is the second in his generational line, and he is twenty-seven sui, born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Chaoxiang, an Assistant Magistrate; his grandfather was Youting; his father was Yu, a County Recorder; his father's first wife was née Wu, and his mother is née Sun. His mother is living. His elder brother is Qi, and his younger brother is Cong. He married née Ni. He placed 124th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 107th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Mao 李茂 is a native of Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in an official household of Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Shirong, he is the third in his generational line, and he is thirty-nine sui, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wenlin, an Administrator; his grandfather was Liwu, an Usher; his father is Yu; and his mother was née Zeng. His father is living. His elder brothers are Yuan and Rong, and his younger brothers are Jinghua (a Drafter), Ying, Hui, and Lan. He married née Guo. He placed 102nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 27th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang He 張和 is registered in a civilian household of Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Metropolitan Area]. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Zongli, he is the second in his generational line, and he is forty-five sui [with an extra character 生], born on the ninth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Dezhong, a District Magistrate under the Yuan; his grandfather was Zhongli; his father was Penghui; and his mother was née Sun. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Chong. He married née Sun, and took née Kan as his second wife. He placed 7th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 65th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yunfeng 陳雲鳳 is registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang. A Confucian Scholar specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Yizhi, he is the twentieth in his generational line, and he is twenty-nine sui, born on the fourth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Lüchu, an Assistant Magistrate; his grandfather was Lubin; his father is Yuequ; and his mother was née Duan. His father is living. His elder brothers are Yunpeng (an Administration Commissioner), Yunlong, and Yun'e (a Prefect). He married née Huang. He placed 29th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 143rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Gao 趙杲 (registered in a military household in Han Subprefecture 漢州, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tinghui 廷輝, third in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Jueneng 覺能, his grandfather was Chongzhou 崇周, his father was Tai 泰, and his mother was née Lu 陸氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ang 昂 and Sheng 昇, and he is married to née Cheng 成氏. He placed twenty-first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liao Dezheng 廖德徵 (registered in an artisan household in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; an Added Student at the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Dezheng 德徵, second in seniority, aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Sun 損, his grandfather was Shang'an 尚安, his father is Jigao 季高, and his mother is née Li 黎氏. Both parents are living. He placed sixtieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Rui 張銳 (registered in a civilian household in Jiangdu County 江都縣, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tuizhi 退之, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhongshi 仲實, his grandfather was Shishen 士紳, his father is Min 珉, and his mother is née Li 李氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Jian 鑑, Zhen 鎭, Qin 欽, and Gang 鋼; his younger brothers are Yue 鉞, Yi 鎰, and Zi 鎡; and he is married to née Chen 陳氏. He Jian 何鑑 [registered in a civilian household in Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; an Added Student at the County School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiguang; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was He Zundao; his grandfather is He Yanguang; his father is He Chongmei; and his mother is née Lü. His grandparents and parents are living. His younger brother is He Jue [? 𨱆]. He married née Shi. He placed 24th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 134th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Gui 劉規 [registered in a civilian household in Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yingqian; first in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the eleventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Sheng [Assistant Magistrate]; his grandfather is Liu Guangming; his father is Liu Gang [Postal Relay Station Master]; and his mother is née Yang. His grandparents and parents are living. He married née Deng. He placed 11th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 100th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yong 張鏞 [registered in a civilian household in Yanshan County, Cangzhou Subprefecture, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Daqi; first in his generation; age thirty-nine, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Shiming; his grandfather was Zhang Youde; his father was Zhang Chun; and his mother was née Dong. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Zhang Yue. He married née Liu. He placed 106th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 176th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Yong 徐鏞 [registered in a military household in Xingguo Subprefecture, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yonghe 用和; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Zongyi 宗一; his grandfather was Xu Yougui 友貴; his father is Xu Zheng 政 [Gentleman for Managing Affairs]; and his mother is née Cong 從. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Yue 鉞, Xu Qin 欽, Xu Hong 鋐, and Xu Yu 鈺. He married née Zhang 張, and took née Xi 奚 as his second wife. He placed nineteenth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Cong 范聰 [registered in a civilian household in Rongchang County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; County Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Dashan 達善; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-five, born on the eighth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Youquan 友拳; his grandfather was Fan Jin 錦; his father is Fan Yongning 永寧; and his mother is née Gong 龔. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Fan Yuanji 元極 and Fan Yuankui 元奎, and his younger brother is Fan Yuanqing 元卿. He married née Yang 楊. He placed fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Chong 熊翀 [registered in a civilian household in Guangzhou Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tengxiao 騰霄; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiong Zizhen 子真; his grandfather was Xiong Biqing 必清; his father was Xiong Shizhong 仕忠; and his mother was née Li 李. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xiong Youdao 友道, Xiong Hui 翬, and Xiong Yi 翼, and his younger brother is Xiong Xie 翓. He married née Li 李. He placed sixty-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin He 林和 [registered in a salt-producer household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hengsu 恒肅; eleventh in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary second month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Renmei 仁美; his grandfather was Lin Yuheng 禹衡; his father was Lin Yongyue 永悅; and his mother was née Chen 陳. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Lin Zhi 智, Lin Xin 信, Lin Ren 仁, Lin Zhong 忠, and Lin Fu 福, and his younger brothers are Lin Yi 義 and Lin Ben 本. He married née Chen 陳. He placed eleventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Jian 李鑑 [registered in Henei County, Huaiqing Prefecture, Henan, under civilian household status; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Kongzhao 孔昭; second in seniority among his brothers; age thirty, born on the fourteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yu 玉; his grandfather was Li Xiang 祥 [posthumously honored as Registrar of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard]; his father is Li Zi 孜 [District Magistrate]; and his mother is Lady Song 宋氏 [invested as Child Nurturer]. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Li Chun 春, and he is married to Lady Mao 毛氏. He ranked eighteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Qian 李謙 [registered in Ziyang County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, under military household status; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Jifu 吉甫; third in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-nine, born on the first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zhongde 仲得; his grandfather was Li Xianneng 顯能; his father was Li Zongzheng 宗政 [Secretary in the Ministry of Works]; his principal mother was Lady Hao 郝氏; and his birth mother was Lady Fan 范氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Li Yan 讞 and Li Xun 訊, his younger brother is Li Rang 讓, and he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He ranked sixty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Yue 方岳 [registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under military household status; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Hengqian 恒謙; first in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Shijian 士堅; his grandfather is Fang Xie 澥 [Messenger]; his father is Fang Xubo 旭伯; and his mother is Lady Dai 戴氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Fang Dai 岱, and he is married to Lady Wu 吳氏. He ranked twentieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Liang 鄭諒 [registered in Haiyang County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong, under civilian household status; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Tingcha 廷察; second in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-four, born on the third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Zongli 宗禮; his grandfather was Zheng Ying 瑛; his father was Zheng Keyou 可由; his father's first wife was Lady Dai 戴氏; and his mother is Lady Lin 林氏. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brother is Zheng Heng 亨, his younger brother is Zheng Feng 鳳, and he is married to Lady Qiu 丘氏. He ranked seventy-third in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.
