雷升〔貫湖廣荆州府江陵縣人，遼東三萬衞軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字大亨，行一，𢆯二十七，七月二十六日生〕。曾祖榮；祖喜春；父普；母葉氏；繼母王氏。具慶下。弟節、頤、謙。娶張氏，繼娶林氏。山東鄉試第三十三名，會試第一百六十六名。

李昊〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣人，應天府上元縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字志遠，行一，𢆯三十七，七月十五日生〕。曾祖德潤；祖構；父彥輝；母朱氏。具慶下。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第七十八名，會試第一百四十七名。

李延壽〔貫山東濟南府新城縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字宗仁，行二，年二十七，正月初七日生〕。曾祖彥實；祖從亮〔贈知縣〕；父泰〔府同知〕；母黃氏〔贈孺人〕；繼母羅氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。兄延年；弟延齡、延福、延祺。娶郝氏。山東鄉試第三十一名，會試第三十七名。

王儼〔貫湖廣岳州府華容縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字民望，行三，年三十三，十二月十二日生〕。曾祖子民〔元知縣〕；祖琛；父致中〔醫學訓科〕；母李氏。具慶下。兄佐；弟偉、傑、倬。娶周氏。湖廣鄉試第五十五名，會試第三十八名。
translation_en:
Lei Sheng 雷升 [originally from Jiangling County 江陵縣, Jingzhou Prefecture 荆州府, Huguang 湖廣, registered in a military household of the Sanwan Guard 三萬衞 in Liaodong 遼東; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Daheng 大亨; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Lei Rong 榮; his grandfather was Lei Xichun 喜春; his father is Lei Pu 普; his mother was née Ye 葉氏; his stepmother is née Wang 王氏. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His younger brothers are Lei Jie 節, Lei Yi 頤, and Lei Qian 謙. He married née Zhang 張氏, and remarried née Lin 林氏. He placed thirty-third in the Shandong 山東 Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hao 李昊 [originally from Kunshan County 崑山縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Zhili 直隸, registered in a civilian household in Shangyuan County 上元縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhiyuan 志遠; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Derun 德潤; his grandfather was Li Gou 構; his father is Li Yanhui 彥輝; his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both parents are living. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed seventy-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yanshou 李延壽 [registered in a military household in Xincheng County 新城縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zongren 宗仁; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yanshi 彥實; his grandfather was Li Congliang 從亮 [posthumously honored as District Magistrate]; his father is Li Tai 泰 [Vice Prefect]; his mother was née Huang 黃氏 [posthumously honored as Child Nurturess (ruren)]; his stepmother is née Luo 羅氏 [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His elder brother is Li Yannian 延年; his younger brothers are Li Yanling 延齡, Li Yanfu 延福, and Li Yanqi 延祺. He married née Hao 郝氏. He placed thirty-first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yan 王儼 [registered in a military household in Huarong County 華容縣, Yuezhou Prefecture 岳州府, Huguang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Minwang 民望; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zimin 子民 [District Magistrate in the Yuan 元 dynasty]; his grandfather was Wang Chen 琛; his father is Wang Zhizhong 致中 [Prefectural/District Medical Schooled-Instructor (yixue xunke)]; his mother is née Li 李氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Zuo 佐; his younger brothers are Wang Wei 偉, Wang Jie 傑, and Wang Zhuo 倬. He married née Zhou 周氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

孫仁〔貫江西臨江府新淦縣民籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字偉德，行五，年四十一，五月十三日生〕。曾祖人立；祖仕賓；父肇鼎；母廖氏。永感下。兄偉任、偉靖、偉度、偉達。娶謝氏，繼娶何氏。江西鄉試第十名，會試第八十五名。

王溥〔貫河南南陽府鄧州內鄉縣醫籍，國子生，治《易經》，字公甫，行一，年二十六，正月十六日生〕。曾祖得〔醫學訓科〕；祖賢〔訓科，贈監察御史〕；父儼〔光祿寺少卿〕；嫡母馮氏〔封孺人〕；生母喬氏。具慶下。弟瀚、淳。娶高氏。河南鄉試第五十五名，會試第五十三名。

王舟〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，儒士，治《禮記》，字弘載，行五，年三十三，九月十一日生〕。曾祖克誠；祖文華；父騶虞；母花氏。慈侍下。兄琠、由、暹、賜；弟含章。娶呂氏。浙江鄉試第二十八名，會試第一百十五名。

李恭〔貫直隸永平府昌黎縣人，遼東都司定遼左衛官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字思敬，行一，年三十七，八月二十日生〕。曾祖伯彥；祖士中；父謙〔指揮同知〕；母洪氏；繼母郭氏。具慶下。弟寬、信、敏、惠。娶郭氏。山東鄉試第五十九名，會試第二百四十八名。
translation_en:
Sun Ren 孫仁 [registered in a civilian household of Xingan County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; County Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Weide; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged forty-one; born on the thirteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Renli; his grandfather was Sun Shibin; his father was Sun Zhaoding; his mother was née Liao. Both parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Sun Weiren, Sun Weijing, Sun Weidu, and Sun Weida. He married née Xie, and subsequently married née He. He placed tenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Pu 王溥 [registered in a medical household of Neixiang County, Dengzhou, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Gongfu; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the sixteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wang De [Prefectural Medical Instructor]; his grandfather was Wang Xian [Medical Instructor, posthumously honored as Investigating Censor]; his father is Wang Yan [Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments]; his legal mother is née Feng [invested as Child Nurturess]; his birth mother is née Qiao. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Han and Wang Chun. He married née Gao. He placed fifty-fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhou 王舟 [registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Confucian scholar; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Hongzai; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three; born on the eleventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Kecheng; his grandfather was Wang Wenhua; his father was Wang Zouyu; his mother is née Hua. His mother is living (father deceased). His elder brothers are Wang Tian, Wang You, Wang Xian, and Wang Ci; his younger brother is Wang Hanzhang. He married née Lü. He placed twenty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Gong 李恭 [a native of Changli County, Yongping Prefecture, Zhili, registered in an official military household of the Dingliao Left Guard under the Liaodong Regional Military Commission; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Sijing; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven; born on the twentieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Boyan; his grandfather was Li Shizhong; his father is Li Qian [Vice Guard Commander]; his mother was née Hong; his stepmother is née Guo. Both father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Li Kuan, Li Xin, Li Min, and Li Hui. He married née Guo. He placed fifty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Gao Quan 高銓 (registered under military household status in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zongxuan; fifth in his generational line; aged twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Gao Yongren; his grandfather was Gao Youzhi; his father is Gao Wentong; and his mother is née Ji. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Gao Jian, Gao Qin, and Gao Zhong; his younger brothers are Gao Zong, Gao Tai, Gao Ying, Gao Zi, and Gao Yue; and he is married to née Xu. He placed twenty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Xiao 唐綃 (registered under military household status in Qiongshan County, Qiongzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shiyong; first in his generational line; aged forty-two, born on the seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Tang Kongxi (District Magistrate); his grandfather was Tang Tian; his father was Tang You; and his mother is née Mo. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Tang Qian (Assistant Instructor) and Tang Gang (Assistant Instructor); his younger brother is Tang Zongqi; he married née Wu and subsequently married née Wang. He placed seventy-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zhu 黃著 (registered under civilian household status in Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Chengfu; first in his generational line; aged thirty-two, born on the ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Yi; his grandfather was Huang Yuanzhi (Instructor); his father was Huang Ping (Registrar of a Provincial Administration Commission); and his mother is née Chen. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Huang Kui, Huang Yi, Huang Cha, and Huang Bi; and he is married to née Qiu. He placed one hundred twenty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Heng 葉亨 (a native of Xiuning County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], registered under civilian household status in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Shutong; third in his generational line; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Ye Tiande; his grandfather is Ye Rang; his father is Ye Min; and his mother is née Lin. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His elder brother is Ye Yongqing (Honorary Official); his younger brothers are Ye Zhen and Ye Xing; and he is married to née Ni. He placed fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:

translation_en:
Zhao Gen 趙艮 (registered in a civilian household of Yongkang County 永康縣, Jinhua Prefecture 金華府, Zhejiang; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shizhong 時中; eighth in seniority; age thirty-seven, born on the eighth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Jishan 繼善; his grandfather was Zhao Xuexing 學興; his father was Zhao Cunyou 存佑; and his mother was Lady Xu 徐氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhao Xun 塤 (Guard Registry (wei jingli)), Zhao Fu 復, Zhao Ci 賜, Zhao Tai 泰, and Zhao Yu 豫; his younger brother is Zhao Chang 昌. He married Lady Ying 應氏. He placed 66th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 103rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Gang 談綱 (registered in an official household of Wuxi County 無錫縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Xianzhang 憲章; third in seniority; age thirty-two, born on the second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Tan Li 禮; his grandfather was Tan Shao 紹 (posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi)); his father is Tan Fu 復; and his mother is Lady Ru 茹氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Tan Jing 經 (Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue (hubu zhushi)) and Tan Wei 緯 (Gentleman for Rendering Service (chengshi lang)); his younger brothers are Tan Wei 維, Tan Yi 繹, Tan Jin 縉, and Tan Shen 紳. He married Lady Zhu 朱氏, and took Lady Qian 錢氏 as his second wife. He placed 15th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jing 王京 (a native of Jiaozhi 交阯 registered in an official household of Xinfeng County 信豐縣, Ganzhou Prefecture 贛州府, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zongzhou 宗周; first in seniority; age thirty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Leshan 樂山 (Grand Scribe (taishi) under the Yuan); his grandfather was Wang Daoyuan 道原; his father is Wang Xuegu 學古 (District Magistrate (zhixian)); and his mother was Lady Fan 范氏. His father is living. His younger brothers are Wang Gong 珙, Wang Zong 宗, Wang Su 素, Wang Fei 棐, and Wang Nai 柰. He married Lady Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 84th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 204th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Shizhong 曹時中 (registered in a military household of Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shizhong 時中; fifth in seniority; age thirty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Rongfu 榮甫; his grandfather was Cao Chuyang 楚暘; his father is Cao Tingxian 廷獻; his mother was Lady Deng 鄧氏, and his stepmother is Lady Sun 孫氏. His father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Cao Shichu 時初, Cao Shiqian 時謙, Cao Shiyong 時用 (National University Student), and Cao Shihe 時和 (metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the jiaxu year [1454]); his younger brother is Cao Shixiu 時脩. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed 62nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 99th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Zunyi 陳遵毅 (registered under a military household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Guihong; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Tianrui, his grandfather was Boqin, his father is Yongji, and his mother is née Li. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhongli and Zhongke, and he is married to née Ouyang. He ranked thirty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Mi 楊謐 (registered under a civilian household in Yifeng County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenning; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-third day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Cheng, his grandfather was Bozhong, his father is Jin (County Assistant Magistrate), his father's former wife was née Lu, and his mother is née Mou. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Qian and Zan, his younger brother is Xun, and he is married to née Jiang. He ranked thirty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Lin 賀霖 (registered under a civilian household in Poyang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiwang; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Yanming (posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review), his grandfather was Siyong, his father was Yongjian, and his mother is née Fang. His mother is living. He is married to née Zheng. He ranked eighty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Gu 張穀 (registered under a salt-producer household in Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bolu; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Ziren, his grandfather was Yuan, his father was Wenjian, his father's former wife was née Chen, and his mother is née Lin. His mother is living. His younger brother is Xuan, and he married née Chen and subsequently married née Chen. He ranked fifty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Liang 李良 (registered in an artisan household in Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Yaochen, first in generational order, aged thirty-five, born on the fifteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Wenxing, his grandfather was Li Ying, his father was Li Gang, his mother was née Zou, and his stepmother is née Zhu. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Zhi, Li Xue, Li Xin, and Li Neng, and he is married to née Xu. He placed 25th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 164th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Guan 劉灌 (registered in a civilian household in Jining Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Huimin, third in generational order, aged thirty-five, born on the fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Liu Congyi, his grandfather was Liu Zirong (posthumously honored as Investigating Censor), his father was Liu Zhen (Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments), and his mother is née Xu (invested as Child Nurturer). His younger brothers are Lin Zhen, Lin Rong, Lin Chou, Lin Zhu, and Lin Renjie, and he is married to née Chen. He placed 82nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 221st in the Metropolitan Examination.

蔡元美〔貫福建興化府莆田縣，民籍。縣學增廣生，治《書經》。字子仁，行二十，年四十，正月十八日生〕。曾祖景德；祖士弘；父則勉，母黃氏，生母林氏。慈侍下。兄元器、元獻、元禮、元爵，弟季肅、元周。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百八十二名。

俞祿〔貫應天府六合縣民籍，浙江嚴州府遂安縣人。國子生，治《春秋》。字從學，行二，年三十三，七月二十三日生〕。曾祖清逺；祖驥；父建，母周氏，繼母呂氏。具慶下。兄從周。娶陳氏。應天府鄉試第八十六名，會試第二十名。
translation_en:
Huang Wenyan 黃文琰 is registered in a civilian household in Qimen County 祁門縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, in the Metropolitan Area 直隸. A National University Student (國子生) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋), his courtesy name is Zongqi 宗器, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Huang Zirong 子榮, his grandfather was Huang Xinren 新仁, his father is Huang Shemi 舍謐, and his mother is née Hu 胡氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Huang Wengui 文珪 (a Tribute Student, gongshi 貢士), and he is married to a woman née Wang 汪氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zhong 陳忠 is registered in a civilian household in Xuzhou 許州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南. A National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經), his courtesy name is Xiaoqing 孝卿, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-four years old, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Chen Dexin 德新, his grandfather is Chen Rong 榮, his father is Chen Fuxue 復學, and his mother is née Wei 魏氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living, and he is married to a woman née Gao 高氏. He placed nineteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Yuanmei 蔡元美 is registered in a civilian household in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建. A Supernumerary County Student (縣學增廣生) specializing in the Classic of Documents, his courtesy name is Ziren 子仁, he is twentieth in seniority among his male cousins and brothers, and he is forty years old, born on the eighteenth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Cai Jingde 景德, his grandfather was Cai Shihong 士弘, his father was Cai Zemian 則勉, his principal mother was née Huang 黃氏, and his birth mother is née Lin 林氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Cai Yuanqi 元器, Cai Yuanxian 元獻, Cai Yuanli 元禮, and Cai Yuanjue 元爵; his younger brothers are Cai Jisu 季肅 and Cai Yuanzhou 元周; and he is married to a woman née Wu 吳氏. He placed twenty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Lu 俞祿 is registered in a civilian household in Liuhe County 六合縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府, and is originally from Sui'an County 遂安縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江. A National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals, his courtesy name is Congxue 從學, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Yu Qingyuan 清逺, his grandfather was Yu Ji 驥, his father is Yu Jian 建, his mother was née Zhou 周氏, and his stepmother is née Lü 呂氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Yu Congzhou 從周, and he is married to a woman née Chen 陳氏. He placed eighty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His younger brothers are Quan, Keng, and Yue; he is married to née Wang. He placed eightieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Changchun 劉長春 (registered in Luzhou Subprefecture, Sichuan, in a salt-producer farming-colony household [竈屯籍]; a Subprefectural Student who specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Cunren 存仁, second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the eighth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Gucheng 穀成, his grandfather was Liu Zhiyong 志永, his father is Liu Duan 端, and his mother is née Zhou 周氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Yangchun 陽春, and he is married to a woman née Min 閔氏. He placed seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 228th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Ji 許楫 (registered in Meizhou Subprefecture, Sichuan, in a military household; a Directorate Student who specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Gongji 公濟, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the tenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yingchun 迎春, his grandfather was Xu Hongdao 宏道, his father was Xu Lian 廉, and his mother is née Zhou 周氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Xu Xiang 相 and Xu Lin 霖, and his younger brothers are Xu Mei 梅, Xu Cai 材, and Xu Nan 楠. He is married to a woman née Zhou 周氏. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong An 董安 (registered in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, in a military household; a Directorate Student who specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Dunren 敦仁, first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Dong Fu 福, his grandfather was Dong Chou 丑, his father is Dong Xuemin 學敏, and his mother is née Huang 黃氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Dong Min 珉, Dong Can 璨, and Dong Ming 明, and he is married to a woman née Lin 林氏. He placed forty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xiong 周熊 (registered in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, in a military household; an Expectant Student of a Confucian Prefectural School who specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Shixiang 世祥, ninth in seniority in his generation; aged twenty-nine, born on the second day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Daoxi 道熈, his grandfather is Zhou Ying 英, his father is Zhou Jin 晉 (Commissioner-in-chief of a Granary), and his mother is née Lin 林氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhou Cheng 澄, Zhou Yuan 淵, Zhou Pu 溥, and Zhou Run 潤, and he is married to a woman née Lin 林氏. He placed fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 197th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Jin 王錦: Registered in a civilian household of Xiangcheng County, Xuzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jiongzhi 絅之; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty, born on the fifth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Shangwen 王尚文, an Administration Vice Commissioner (canyi); his grandfather was Wang Jingdao 王景道, posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue (Hubu langzhong); his father is Wang Rang 王壤, Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue; and his mother is née Sheng 盛氏, invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren). Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Wang Luan 王鑾 and Wang Ying 王鎣; he is married to née Jiao 焦氏. He placed 72nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 223rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Yao 戴瑶: Registered in a civilian household of Ruyang County, Runing Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhongyi 仲儀; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Dai Xin 戴信; his grandfather was Dai Zicong 戴子聰; his father is Dai Qin 戴欽; and his mother is née Xia 夏氏. Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Dai Zeng 戴增 and Dai Cong 戴琮; he is married to née Li 李氏. He placed 3rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 40th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zhao 李釗: Registered in a military household of Luoyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mengyuan 孟遠; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Li Zhongliang 李仲良; his grandfather is Li Rang 李讓; his father is Li Cheng 李誠, a Government Student (shengyuan); his mother was née Xing 邢氏; and his stepmother is née Lü 吕氏. His grandparents and parents are living; his younger brother is Li Zhu 李鑄; he is married to née Wang 王氏. He placed 22nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 68th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yi 張翊: Registered in a military household of Panyu County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingbi 廷弼; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Pushou 張普壽; his grandfather is Zhang Yancheng 張彦珵, invested as Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue (Hubu zhushi); his father is Zhang Rui 張瑞; his mother was née Mai 麥氏; and his stepmother is née Zou 鄒氏. His grandparents and parents are living; his elder brother is Zhang Ao 張翺, and his younger brothers are Zhang Qiao 張翹, Zhang Xu 張詡, Zhang Ao 張翱, Zhang Fan 張翻, Zhang Yao 張𦑃, Zhang Zhu 張翥, Zhang Xiang 張翔, Zhang Chi 張䎉, Zhang Pian 張翩, and Zhang Chong 張翀; he is betrothed to née Chen 陳氏. He placed 59th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 12th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Gong 李恭: Registered in a civilian household in Qi County 淇縣, Weihui Prefecture 衛輝府, Henan 河南; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhijing 致敬, second in seniority among his brothers, aged forty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Li Mao 茂; his grandfather was Li Yancai 彥才; his father was Li Qin 欽; and his mother was née Zhao 趙氏. Both his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brother is Li Zheng 整, and his younger brothers are Li Wang 旺 and Li Duo 鐸. He married née Wei 魏氏, and remarried née Wang 王氏. He placed 62nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Fan 周蕃: Registered in a civilian household in Changshou County 長壽縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shichang 世昌, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhou Gui 貴; his grandfather was Zhou Shaojing 紹敬, posthumously granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue (Hubu zhushi); his father was Zhou Tianmin 天民, Prefect (zhifu); his mother was née Chen 陳氏, posthumously granted the title of Mistress of Peace (anren); and his stepmothers were née He 何氏 and née Dan 但氏, invested with the title of Mistress of Peace. His father is deceased and his mother/stepmother is living (cishi xia). His younger brothers are Zhou Hua 華 (a National University Student), Zhou Fen 蕡, Zhou Zhen 蓁, and Zhou Chai 茝. He married née Zhang 張氏, and remarried née Huang 黃氏. He placed 33rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 241st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Tan 王坦: Registered in a military household in Pingyuan County 平原縣, Dezhou 德州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yanping 彥平, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the fourth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Wang Jingxian 敬先; his grandfather was Wang Ying 瑛; his father is Wang Fan 蕃; and his mother is née Wei 魏氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His younger brothers are Wang Jian 健, Wang De 德, and Wang Zhi 穉. He married née Pei 裴氏. He placed 53rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 8th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Qiong 劉瓊: Registered in a military household in Shunyi County 順義縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; a Confucian Scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dewen 德溫, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Yi 義; his grandfather was Liu Duo 鐸, Assistant Magistrate (zhubu); his father is Liu Che 澈, Vice Prefect (fu tongzhi); his mother was née Dong 董氏; and his stepmother is née Zhang 張氏. His father and mother/stepmother are both living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Liu Yao 瑤 and Liu Cong 璁. He married née Ma 馬氏. He placed 28th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 133rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Cai Su 蔡肅 (registered in a civilian household of Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; National University Student [Guozisheng 國子生]; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji 禮記]; courtesy name Kegong 克恭; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Cai Wang 王; his grandfather was Cai Keng 鏗; his father is Cai Kongqing 孔清, and his mother is née Lin 林氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia 具慶下). His elder brother is Cai Tang 堂, and his younger brother is Cai Yu 禹. He is married to née Wu 吳氏. He placed thirty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong You 熊佑 (registered in a civilian household of Boxing County 博興縣, Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong 山東; National University Student [Guozisheng 國子生]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Liangzuo 良佐; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Xiong Jiugong 九功; his grandfather was Xiong Zhixian 志賢; his father was Xiong Tai 泰 (County Assistant Magistrate [Xian zhubu 縣主簿]), his father's former wife was née Li 李氏, and his mother is née Ji 紀氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia 慈侍下). His elder brother is Xiong Fu 福. He is married to née Liu 劉氏. He placed sixtieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Mao 徐瑁 (registered in a military household of Yongnian County 永年縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, Southern or Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; National University Student [Guozisheng 國子生]; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu 春秋]; courtesy name Tingbi 廷璧; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Zhongliang 仲良; his grandfather was Xu Youliang 友諒; his father is Xu Xuan 宣, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia 具慶下). He is married to née Wang 王氏. He placed twentieth in the Shuntian 順天府 Provincial Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gong Yuan 龔沅 (registered in a military household of Jian'an County 建安縣, Jianning Prefecture 建寧府, Fujian 福建; National University Student [Guozisheng 國子生]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Kongyin 孔殷; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Gong Yanzhang 彥章; his grandfather was Gong Ren 仁 (granted the title of Junior Compiler in the Hanlin Academy [Hanlinyuan bianxiu 翰林院編脩]); his father was Gong Qi 錡 (Junior Compiler in the Hanlin Academy [Hanlinyuan bianxiu 翰林院編脩]), and his mother was née Chen 陳氏 (granted the title of Child Nurturer [Ruren 孺人]). Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia 永感下). His elder brother is Gong Jiong 泂, and his younger brother is Gong Qing 清. He is married to née Liu 劉氏. He placed eleventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yang Cheng 楊澄 [registered in Shehong County, Tongchuan Subprefecture, Sichuan, under civilian household status; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xianfu; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the seventh day of the first lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Qing; his grandfather was Yang Jing'an; his father was Yang Shaoguang; his principal mother was Lady Xian, his birth mother was Lady Zhao, and his stepmother was Lady Fei. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Yang Duan and Yang Ben, and his younger brothers are Yang Yuan, Yang Chong, and Yang Yun. He married Lady Fu, and subsequently married Lady Yang. He placed fifty-fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Li 陳鯉 [registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian household status; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tenglong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Dehui; his grandfather was Chen Wenshan; his father is Chen Shiruo; and his mother is Lady Huang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Chen Zhan. He married Lady Lin. He placed forty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Yuanji 羅元吉 [registered in Yuci County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, under civilian household status; National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Dachang; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the ninth day of the third lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Luo Xizu; his grandfather was Luo Zi [District Jailor]; his father is Luo Qing; his mother was Lady Zhang, and his stepmother is Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Luo Yuanheng, and his younger brothers are Luo Yuanxiang [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Luo Yuanqing, Luo Yuantai, Luo Yuanming, Luo Yuanliang, Luo Yuanlong, and Luo Yuanfeng. He married Lady Zhang. He placed first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Tong 董通 [registered in Linfen County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi, under military household status; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yanda; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the third lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Cheng; his grandfather was Dong Shiliang; his father is Dong Qin; and his mother is Lady Shi. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Dong Da. He married Lady Zhang. He placed eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Mi 陳密 (registered in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, under civilian household status; Confucian Scholar (rushi) specializing in the Book of Changes; courtesy name Cunyi; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the fourth day of the intercalary tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Weishan (Physician-in-Ordinary), his grandfather was Chen Ciquan, his father was Chen Zhongru, and his mother was née Liang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Chen Qi (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner), Chen Ji, Chen Jun (Medical Technician), Chen Jian, and Chen Fan; his younger brother is Chen Lin. He married née Guan. He placed 54th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 237th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ang 劉昂 (registered in Haifeng County, Wuding Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, under civilian household status; National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents; courtesy name Tingju; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Chengfu, his grandfather was Liu Wenmei (Police Chief), his father is Liu Xian, his father's former wife was née Zhang, and his mother is née Gao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Hui, and his younger brothers are Liu Bao, Liu Yu, Liu Hao, and Liu Gong. He married née Wang. He placed 24th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 64th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xi Hao 奚昊 (registered in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], under civilian household status; Added Student at the Prefectural Confucian School specializing in the Book of Odes; courtesy name Shiheng; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xi Xingyi, his grandfather was Xi Wenzheng, his father was Xi Sheng (Subprefectural Magistrate), and his mother is née Liang. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Xi Yuan, Xi Mian, and Xi Ang. He married née Pan. He placed 106th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 196th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jing 李鏡 (registered in Yiyang County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household status; National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents; courtesy name Wenming; forty-fifth in seniority in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the eleventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Li Tingchun, his grandfather was Li Chongsu, his father was Li Shouheng, and his mother is née Zhao. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Li Qi and Li Xian. He married née Zhan. He placed 80th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 50th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
徐謙〔貫河南開封府陳州太康縣人，羽林前衛官籍，順天府學生，治《春秋》，字伯亨，行二，年三十三，五月十六日生〕。曾祖普義；祖彥方；父文祥；母王氏。嚴侍下。兄讓；弟謹、讚、誌。娶潘氏，繼娶陳氏。順天府鄉試第七十名，會試第七十二名。

姜天錫〔貫四川都司寧川衛軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字祐之，行四，年三十四，六月十四日生〕。曾祖文清；祖時秀；父澄；前母李氏、蔣氏，母蔣氏。慈侍下。兄天鍾、天鏞、天鐸。娶馬氏，繼娶耿氏、童氏。四川鄉試第三十五名，會試第一百三十二名。

丁鏞〔貫應天府上元縣匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字鳳儀，行三，年三十五，二月初一日生〕。曾祖福二；祖伯通；父禮；母唐氏。慈侍下。兄鑑、鎧；弟鈺。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第八十一名，會試第三十一名。

李俊〔貫狹西鳳翔府岐山縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字子英，行一，年三十九，七月二十日生〕。曾祖克用；祖智；父賜；母曹氏。慈侍下。娶袁氏。狹西鄉試第十七名，會試第二百四十四名。
translation_en:
Xu Qian 徐謙 (natively from Taikang County in Chenzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, registered in an official household of the Front Forest of Plumes Guard; a student of the Shuntian Prefectural School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Boheng; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Puyi, his grandfather was Yanfang, his father is Wenxiang, and his mother was Lady Wang. His father is living. His elder brother is Rang, and his younger brothers are Jin, Zan, and Zhi. He married Lady Pan, and subsequently married Lady Chen. He placed seventieth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Tianxi 姜天錫 (registered in a military household of the Ningchuan Guard under the Sichuan Regional Military Commission; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Youzhi; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wenqing, his grandfather was Shixiu, his father was Cheng, his father's former wives were Lady Li and Lady Jiang, and his mother is Lady Jiang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Tianzhong, Tianyong, and Tianduo. He married Lady Ma, and subsequently married Lady Geng and Lady Tong. He placed thirty-fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Yong 丁鏞 (registered in an artisan household of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Fengyi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Fu'er, his grandfather was Botong, his father was Li, and his mother is Lady Tang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Jian and Kai, and his younger brother is Yu. He married Lady Zhang. He placed eighty-first in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jun 李俊 (registered in a commoner household of Qishan County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Ziying; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Keyong, his grandfather was Zhi, his father was Ci, and his mother is Lady Cao. His mother is living. He married Lady Yuan. He placed seventeenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
何俊〔貫湖廣郴州軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字廷彥，行七，年四十三，三月初十日生〕。曾祖德翁，祖仁海，父義堅〔同知州〕，前母袁氏，母鄧氏。慈侍下。兄琛〔千戶〕、儀、琮、俱、瑄、瑜，弟价。娶廖氏。湖廣鄉試第七十八名，會試第一百九十一名。

葉祚〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣人，武功左衛軍籍，軍餘，治《春秋》，字應福，行三，年三十二，二月二十三日生〕。曾祖長，祖敏，父華，母陳氏，繼母吳氏。慈侍下。兄佐、祐，弟冕、時、昱。娶蔡氏，繼娶王氏。順天府鄉試第十三名，會試第一百六十二名。

李鸞〔貫河南汝寧府確山縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字廷儀，行二，年三十一，十月初五日生〕。曾祖順中，祖榮〔訓導〕，父延豐，母洪氏。具慶下。兄鳳。娶黃氏。河南鄉試第三十二名，會試第一百四十六名。

徐瓚〔貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣人，太醫院醫士，治《詩經》，字國用，行三，年三十四，五月二十八日生〕。曾祖潤德，祖秉中，父文昭〔典史〕，母范氏。嚴侍下。兄珪〔國子生〕、璋，弟璧、玉。娶莊氏。順天府鄉試第一百二十名，會試第七十六名。
translation_en:
He Jun 何俊 [registered in a military household in Chen Subprefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Tingyan; seventh in seniority among his brothers; forty-three sui, born on the tenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Deweng, his grandfather was Renhai, his father was Yijian [Vice Subprefectural Magistrate], his father's first wife was née Yuan, and his mother is née Deng. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Chen [Battalion Commander], Yi, Cong, Ju, Xuan, and Yu; his younger brother is Jie. He married née Liao. He placed seventy-eighth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Zuo 葉祚 [a native of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in a military household of the Left Guard of Martial Merit (Wugong Zuowei); a supernumerary soldier (junyu) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Yingfu; third in seniority; thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-third day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Chang, his grandfather was Min, his father was Hua, his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Wu. His stepmother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Zuo and You; his younger brothers are Mian, Shi, and Yu. He married née Cai, and remarried née Wang. He placed thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Luan 李鸞 [registered in a civilian household in Queshan County, Runing Prefecture, Henan; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Tingyi; second in seniority; thirty-one sui, born on the fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Shunzhong, his grandfather was Rong [Assistant Instructor], his father is Yanfeng, and his mother is née Hong. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Feng. He married née Huang. He placed thirty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zan 徐瓚 [a native of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Medical Practitioner (yishi) in the Imperial Academy of Medicine (Taiyiyuan) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Guoyong; third in seniority; thirty-four sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Runde, his grandfather was Bingzhong, his father is Wenzhao [Unclassified Jailor], and his mother was née Fan. His father is living (yanshi xia). His elder brothers are Gui [student of the Directorate of Education] and Zhang; his younger brothers are Bi and Yu. He married née Zhuang. He placed one hundred and twentieth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
柳應辰〔貫湖廣岳州府巴陵縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字拱之，行一，年二十八，八月二十六日生〕。曾祖正華，祖冕〔訓導〕，父珎〔教諭〕，母叚氏。具慶下。弟應軫、應奎、應張。娶易氏。湖廣鄉試第二十二名，會試第八十九名。

陳鳳〔貫四川保寧府巴縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文瑞，行一，年三十一，十一月十七日生〕。曾祖敬親，祖銘，父琳，母李氏，繼母王氏。具慶下。弟翔。娶趙氏。四川鄉試第十二名，會試第八十四名。

周郁〔貫直隸河間府阜城縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字文盛，行三，年四十，二月初十日生〕。曾祖耀先，祖士英，父全，母趙氏。永感下。兄敬、榮，弟林。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第四十七名，會試第一百二十名。

毛泰〔貫河南開封府蘭陽縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字時亨，行一，年二十七，九月初五日生〕。曾祖天祥，祖倫〔教諭〕，父存誠〔監察御史〕，母孫氏，繼母王氏。重慶下。弟瀚、濟、淮。娶王氏。河南鄉試第七十名，會試第一百十四名。
translation_en:
Liu Yingchen 柳應辰 is registered in a civilian household of Baling County 巴陵縣, Yuezhou Prefecture 岳州府, Huguang 湖廣, and is a Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name is Gongzhi 拱之, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-eight years old, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Zhenghua 正華, his grandfather was Liu Mian 冕, an Assistant Instructor (xundao), his father is Liu Zhen 珎, an Instructor (jiaoyu), and his mother is née Duan 叚. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yingzhen 應軫, Yingkui 應奎, and Yingzhang 應張, and he married a woman née Yi 易. He placed twenty-second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Feng 陳鳳 is registered in a civilian household of Ba County 巴縣, Baoning Prefecture 保寧府, Sichuan 四川, and is a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); his courtesy name is Wenrui 文瑞, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-one years old, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Chen Jingqin 敬親, his grandfather was Chen Ming 銘, his father is Chen Lin 琳, his mother was née Li 李, and his stepmother is née Wang 王. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Xiang 翔, and he married a woman née Zhao 趙. He placed twelfth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Yu 周郁 is registered in a military household of Fucheng County 阜城縣, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Zhili 直隸, and is a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name is Wensheng 文盛, he is third in seniority among his brothers, and he is forty years old, born on the tenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Zhou Yaoxian 耀先, his grandfather was Zhou Shiying 士英, his father was Zhou Quan 全, and his mother was née Zhao 趙. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Jing 敬 and Rong 榮, his younger brother is Lin 林, and he married a woman née Wang 王. He placed forty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Tai 毛泰 is registered in a civilian household of Lanyang County 蘭陽縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, and is a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name is Shiheng 時亨, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-seven years old, born on the fifth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Mao Tianxiang 天祥, his grandfather is Mao Lun 倫, an Instructor (jiaoyu), his father is Mao Cuncheng 存誠, an Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi), his mother was née Sun 孫, and his stepmother is née Wang 王. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Han 瀚, Ji 濟, and Huai 淮, and he married a woman née Wang 王. He placed seventieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Cong 張璁 (native of Lishui County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; registered in an official household in Pingyi Guard, Yunnan; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Tingbi; twenty-third in generational seniority; aged thirty-one; born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Jun, his grandfather was Zhang Bin (Battalion Commander), his father is Zhang Rong (Guard Judge), and his mother is Lady Cao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Lin (Guard Judge) and Zhang Qi, and he is married to Lady Lu. He placed thirtieth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Lun 姚倫 (registered in a civilian household in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Dalun; second in generational seniority; aged forty; born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Dezhen, his grandfather was Yao Xian, his father is Yao Ao (Instructor), and his mother was Lady Liu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Yao Jing, and he is married to Lady Zhang. He placed twelfth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and two hundred fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Lan 祝瀾 (registered in a civilian household in Dexing County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Youben; seventh in generational seniority; aged thirty-four; born on the twenty-first day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Zhongming, his grandfather was Zhu Shaohu, his father was Zhu Zhen'an, and his mother is Lady Dong. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhu Pu, Zhu Song, Zhu Kuang, Zhu Shu, and Zhu Huan; his younger brother is Zhu Zhan; and he is married to Lady Shu. He placed eighteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xuan 王玹 (registered in a civilian household in Yanshan County, Cangzhou, Hejian Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Bangqi; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven; born on the first day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Neng, his grandfather is Wang Gui, his father is Wang Gan, and his mother is Lady Yang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Yu, Wang Rui, Wang Qiong, and Wang Yao, and he is married to Lady Xu. He placed forty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Jin 李進 [registered in a military household of Quwo County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shimian; first in his generation-rank; age thirty-one, born on the third day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Xian, his grandfather was Li Sicheng, his father is Li Yue, and his mother is née Wang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Xi, Li Yun, and Li Qian. He is married to a woman née Wang. He placed 19th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 187th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bao Qi 鮑麒 [registered in a civilian household of Pingyang County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Zhongrui; third in his generation-rank; age thirty-six, born on the tenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Bao Deshan, his grandfather was Bao Shigao [posthumously honored as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice], his father was Bao Shumao, and his mother is née Han. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Bao Kui and Bao Yong, and his younger brothers are Bao Feng, Bao Luan, Bao Lin, Bao Long, Bao Hu, Bao Bao, Bao E, and Bao Que. He married a woman née Qiu, and remarried a woman née Yang. He placed 70th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 113th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Jing 樊經 [registered in a civilian household of Lizhou Department, Yuezhou Prefecture, Huguang; Department Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Dajing; third in his generation-rank; age twenty-six, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Bin, his grandfather was Fan Ruyu, his father is Fan Mao [Granary Commissioner-in-chief], and his mother is née Wu. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Fan Gang and Fan Ji, and his younger brothers are Fan Lun, Fan Wei, and Fan Shen. He is married to a woman née Huang. He placed 1st in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 127th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Shoufu 朱守孚 [registered in a military household of Guiyang County, Chenzhou Subprefecture, Huguang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Zhongfu; first in his generation-rank; age thirty-six, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Panqi [County Assistant Magistrate], his grandfather was Zhu Sijian [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor], his father is Zhu Ying [Right Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission], and his mother is née Hu [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhu Shouyi, Zhu Shouqian, Zhu Shoumeng, Zhu Shoubi, and Zhu Shouheng. He married a woman née He, and remarried a woman née Chen. He placed 39th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 128th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Shao Hui 邵暉, courtesy name Rizhao 日昭, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the eighth day of the fifth month, was registered under a commoner household in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), and was a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Shao Mengwen 孟文, his grandfather Shao Dequan 德全, his father Shao Xuan 瑄, and his mother Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents were living; he had an elder brother, Shao Huan 煥, and a younger brother, Shao Dan 旦, and was married to Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed thirty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yan 張衍, courtesy name Jingxian 敬先, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month, was registered under a commoner household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), and was a prefectural student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Zhang Fu'er 富二, his grandfather Zhang Ming 明, his father Zhang Zhengzong 正宗, and his mother Lady Guo 郭氏. His mother was living; he had a younger brother, Zhang Kan 衎, and was married to Lady Fang 方氏. He placed nineteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Gui 方珪, courtesy name Chunjie 純潔, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the first month, was registered under a military household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, and was a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Odes (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Fang Siguang 思廣, his grandfather Fang Tingji 廷積, his father Fang Bingling 秉齡, and his mother Lady Chen 陳氏. Both his parents and grandparents were living; he had younger brothers Fang Zhang 璋 and Fang Shan 珊, and was married to Lady Wang 王氏. He placed forty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Yu 盧瑀, courtesy name Xiyu 希玉, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the tenth day of the fourth month, was registered under a military household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Lu Xiangqing 祥卿 (District Magistrate), his grandfather Lu Jing 敬, his father Lu Bing 栟, and his mother Lady Xu 許氏. His mother was living; he had elder brothers Lu Qi 玘 and Lu Lin 璘, and a younger brother Lu Lin 琳; he was married to Lady Mu 穆氏, and subsequently married Lady Ni 倪氏. He placed forty-third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Hong 鄭宏 (registered as an artisan household in Guangshan County 光山縣, Guangzhou Subprefecture 光州, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Dechong 德崇; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the sixth day of the first lunar month). His great-grandfather was Yuanli 原禮, his grandfather was Qin 欽, his father was Chang 昌, and his mother is née Cheng 程氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are You 宥 and Xian 憲. He is married to née Qiu 丘氏. He placed 5th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 150th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Hong 顧竑 (registered as a civilian household in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Weiyuan 惟遠; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the fifth day of the second lunar month). His great-grandfather was Defu 德甫, his grandfather was Boyong 伯雍, his father is Yinzhong 寅仲, and his mother was née Cao 曹氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Duan 端, and his younger brothers are Xi 曦, Yi 翊, and Jin 𤦺. He is married to née Du 杜氏. He placed 65th in the Yingtian Prefectural [應天府] Provincial Examination and 43rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Jie 吳傑 (registered as a civilian household in Jiangdu County 江都縣, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tingchen 廷臣; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty; born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh lunar month). His great-grandfather was Fuyi 福乙, his grandfather is Zhongbin 仲賓, his father is Run 潤, and his mother is née Jia 賈氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Jun 俊, Fang 倣, Shen 伸, Zuo 佐, and Lun 倫. He is married to née Gao 高氏. He placed 67th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 216th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Mian 蕭冕 (registered as a civilian household in Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingmian 廷冕; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty; born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth lunar month). His great-grandfather was Zhigang 志剛, his grandfather is Zigong 子貢, his father is Mengsong 孟淞, his mother was née Liu 劉氏, and his stepmother is née Peng 彭氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Tingxu 廷頊, and his younger brothers are Tingxun 廷旬 and Shen 紳. He is married to née Luo 羅氏. He placed 81st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 160th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Jie 徐傑 [registered as an artisan household in Datong County, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Minwang, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Quan; his grandfather was Jingzhong; his father is Gui; his father's former wife was née Cao; his mother was née Zhang; and his stepmother is née Meng. His father and stepmother are both living (juqing xia). He married née Zhao, and subsequently married née Liu. He placed 35th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 145th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Zuo 顧佐 [registered as a commoner household in Linhuai County, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Prefectural Student, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Liangbi, first in seniority, aged twenty-seven, born on the fourteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yangao; his grandfather was Ying [posthumously honored as Subprefectural Magistrate (zhizhou)]; his father was Zhen [Administrative Aide (zhizhong)]; his father's former wife was née Yin [enfeoffed as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]; and his mother is née Kang [enfeoffed as Lady of Suitability]. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brother is Qing; his younger brothers are You and Lun. He married née Huang. He placed 10th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 66th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jun 李濬 [registered as a commoner household in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; Prefectural Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Deshen, third in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the third day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Fujiu; his grandfather was Yanheng; his father was Hao [District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father's former wife was née Zhu; and his mother is née Gu. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Cheng and Quan; his younger brothers are Pu and Han. He married née Zhuang. He placed 59th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 45th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Gui 薛珪 [registered as a commoner household in Lincheng County, Zhao Subprefecture, Zhending Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area; Student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingqi, forty-second in seniority, aged thirty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Hongyou; his grandfather was Zhigang [enfeoffed as Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue (Hubu yuanwailang)]; his father is Gan [Vice Director of the Pasturage Office (Yuanmasi shaoqing)]; and his mother is née Zhang [enfeoffed as Lady of Suitability]. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Jin, Li [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination graduate (gongshi)], and Qi [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination graduate]; his younger brother is Zhang. He married née Li. He placed 78th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 158th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Both parents are living; his elder brother is Tao (Investigating Censor), and his younger brothers are Xian and Da. He married née Yang. He placed 63rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 225th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Jiong 鄭炯 (registered under a military household in Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Shuliang 叔亮, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the seventeenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Bojing 伯敬, his grandfather was Zheng Jue 珏, his father was Zheng Wen 玟, and his mother was Lady Zeng 曾氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living; his younger brothers are Zheng Hui 煇, Zheng Xun 燻, Zheng Yu 煜, and Zheng Bing 炳; he married Lady Liang 梁氏. His great-grandfather was Wang Sicheng 思誠, his grandfather was Wang Zhongli 仲禮, his father was Wang Xun 循, his mother was Lady Feng 馮氏, and his stepmother is Lady Guo 郭氏. His father and stepmother are both living; his elder brother is Wang Min 敏, and his younger brothers are Wang Que 闋, Wang Kai 開, Wang Xian 閒, Wang Gui 閨, and Wang Shen 慎; he married Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed twelfth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Lun 張倫 (registered under a military household in Huang County 黃縣, Dengzhou Prefecture 登州府, Shandong 山東; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing 書經]; courtesy name Zongdao 宗道, second in seniority, aged twenty-six, born on the ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Xin 信, his grandfather was Zhang Bi 弼, his father is Zhang Hui 輝 (District Magistrate), his father's former wife was Lady Liu 劉氏, and his mother is Lady Shen 申氏. Both his parents are living; his elder brother is Zhang Wei 偉 (Honorary Official), and his younger brothers are Zhang Quan 佺 and Zhang Ren 仁; he married Lady Song 宋氏. He placed eleventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zuo 吳祚 (registered under a civilian household in Chun'an County 淳安縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu 春秋]; courtesy name Tianbao 天保, seventh in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Zuyin 祖蔭, his grandfather was Wu Fangyuan 芳遠, his father is Wu Jin 晉 (Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice), his father's former wife was Lady Fang 方氏 (posthumously honored as Lady of Suitability), and his mother was Lady Ying 應氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability). His father is living; his elder brothers are Wu Xi 禧, Wu Chan 禪, Wu Fu 福 (Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of War), Wu Ruqi 汝器, Wu Zongqi 宗器, and Wu Zhenqi 珍器, and his younger brother is Wu Gongqi 公器; he married Lady Hu 胡氏. He placed thirty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
皇帝制曰朕紹承大寶
圖底丕平雖宵旰
勤勵然績效罕著
略舉其端諏尔多
士擇材於文以理
===
民授功於武以馭
兵也今銓衡塗壅
衞所貟溢奚以疏
通之昔人所謂名
利相均虛實相濟

圖厎丕平雖宵旰

畧舉其端諒尒多
士擇材於文以理
===
民援功於武以馭
兵也今銓衡塗轍
衛所貟溢奚以疏
通之昔人所謂名
利相均虛實相濟

translation_en: The Emperor's decree reads: "We have succeeded to the Great Treasure, seeking to bring about grand peace. Yet although We labor diligently from before dawn until late at night, concrete achievements are rarely seen. We shall briefly set forth the main points to consult with you many scholars: We select talent from the civil service in order to govern the people, and reward merit in the military service in order to command the troops. Nowadays, the pathways of personnel selection are clogged, and the quotas of officers in the Guards and Battalions are overflowing; how can this congestion be cleared? As for what the ancients called balancing honor and material reward, and making nominal titles and actual posts complement each other, …

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
可推廣而施歟歲
無常稔者天之道
土有常懷者人之
情也今歉則糴貴
貧則民徙奚以綏
===
輯之前代所行常
平有法均田有制
可稽倣而為歟夫
兼資文武以周一
世之用裁成天地
alt_text:
可推廣而施歟歲
無常歛者天之道
土有常懷者人之
情也今歟則糴貴
貧則民徙奚以綏
===
輯之前代所行常
平有法均田有制
可稽倣而爲歟夫
兼資文武以圖一
世之用裁成天地
punctuated: 可推廣而施歟？歲無常稔者，天之道；土有常懷者，人之情也。今歉則糴貴，貧則民徙，奚以綏輯之？前代所行常平有法，均田有制，可稽倣而為歟？夫兼資文武以周一世之用，裁成天地
translation_en: … can this be extended and put into practice? That the harvest is not always abundant is the Way of Heaven; that people always cherish their native soil is human nature. Now, when harvests fail, grain becomes costly to buy, and when the people fall into poverty, they migrate away; how can they be pacified and gathered together? In former dynasties, there were the regulations of the Ever-Normal Granaries (changping) and the system of Equal-Field land allotment (juntian); can these be examined, imitated, and put into effect? Now, drawing simultaneously upon civil and military talent to meet the needs of a whole generation, and regulating and completing the work of Heaven and Earth…

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
以遂萬姓之安固
濟時切務也若乃
致治大道必有至
言古之臣獻言於
君或得聖道之經
===
而流於迂或得聖
道之權而流於詐
或辯矣而術不密
或智矣而文不及
今尔多士陳四者

translation_en: …so as to achieve peace for the myriad people—these are indeed urgent tasks for aiding the times. As for the great Way of bringing about order, there must be consummate words. When ministers of antiquity presented words to their ruler, some grasped the constant principles of the sagely Way yet lapsed into impracticality; some grasped the expedient adaptations of the sagely Way yet lapsed into deceit; some were eloquent, yet their methods were not thorough; some were wise, yet their literary expression fell short. Now you, the many scholars, in setting forth the tasks regarding these four matters…

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
臣張昇
臣對臣聞治本於道道本於誠非道不足以善治非
誠不足以立道盖道為治之本誠又道之本也有其
道然後能致其治有其誠然後能盡其道是誠也者
萬善之原萬事之本推之無不準動之無不化以之
擇材於文則真材無不得拔功於武則武將無不善
以之因天時以利民而民生無不遂因地利以厚民
而民居無不安文武于焉而兼資而用無不周天地
于焉而財成而功無不著人君為治之道豈越乎此
哉故曾子傳大學有曰意誠而后心正身脩家齊國
===
治天下平子思作中庸亦曰凡為天下國家有九經所
以行之者一也一即誠也大哉誠乎其治道之本乎欽惟
皇帝陛下聖神文武剛健中正上承
天命下得人心即位以来五年于茲民物阜安風俗醇美
四夷咸賓萬方樂業凡所以致治保邦持盈守成之
道至矣盡矣然猶
體道謙冲遊心高遠銳於圖治切於求言萬幾之暇特
進臣等于
廷降賜
清問詢以兼資文武之要財成天地之道顧臣一介庸

清問詢以兼資文武之要財成天地之道顧臣一介庸
punctuated:
臣張昇。
臣對：臣聞治本於道，道本於誠。非道不足以善治，非誠不足以立道。盖道為治之本，誠又道之本也。有其道然後能致其治，有其誠然後能盡其道。是誠也者，萬善之原，萬事之本。推之無不準，動之無不化。以之擇材於文，則真材無不得；拔功於武，則武將無不善。以之因天時以利民，而民生無不遂；因地利以厚民，而民居無不安。文武于焉而兼資，而用無不周；天地于焉而財成，而功無不著。人君為治之道，豈越乎此哉？故曾子傳《大學》有曰：「意誠而后心正，身脩，家齊，國治，天下平。」子思作《中庸》亦曰：「凡為天下國家有九經，所以行之者一也。」一即誠也。大哉誠乎！其治道之本乎！欽惟皇帝陛下，聖神文武，剛健中正，上承天命，下得人心。即位以来，五年于茲，民物阜安，風俗醇美，四夷咸賓，萬方樂業。凡所以致治保邦、持盈守成之道，至矣盡矣！然猶體道謙冲，遊心高遠，銳於圖治，切於求言。萬幾之暇，特進臣等于廷，降賜清問，詢以兼資文武之要，財成天地之道。顧臣一介庸…
translation_en:
Your servant Zhang Sheng 張昇.
Your servant replies: Your servant has heard that governance is rooted in the Way (dao 道), and the Way is rooted in sincerity (cheng 誠). Without the Way, one cannot perfect governance; without sincerity, one cannot establish the Way. Indeed, the Way is the root of governance, and sincerity in turn is the root of the Way. Only when one possesses the Way can one bring about good governance, and only when one possesses sincerity can one fully realize the Way. This sincerity is the source of the myriad goods and the foundation of the myriad affairs. Extended outward, there is nothing to which it does not apply as a standard; set in motion, there is nothing it does not transform. If by means of it one selects talent in the civil sphere, no true talent will fail to be obtained; if one promotes merit in the military sphere, no military commander will fail to excel. If by means of it one accords with the seasons of Heaven to benefit the people, the people's livelihood will never fail to be fulfilled; if one accords with the advantages of Earth to enrich the people, the people's dwellings will never fail to be secure. Civil and military capabilities are thereby drawn upon together, and their application is all-encompassing; Heaven and Earth are thereby regulated and completed, and the achievement is everywhere manifest. How could the Way of a ruler's governance go beyond this? Thus, when Zengzi 曾子 transmitted the Great Learning (Daxue 大學), he said: "When the intentions are sincere, the mind is rectified, the person is cultivated, the family is regulated, the state is rightly governed, and the world is at peace." And when Zisi 子思 composed the Doctrine of the Mean (Zhongyong 中庸), he likewise said: "In all governance of the world and the state there are nine standard rules, and that by which they are practiced is one." That "one" is sincerity. Great indeed is sincerity! Is it not the very foundation of the Way of governance?
Your servant reverently reflects that Your Majesty the Emperor is sagely and神-like, accomplished in both the civil and the military, resolute, vigorous, balanced, and upright, receiving the Mandate of Heaven above and winning the hearts of the people below. Five years have now passed since Your Majesty ascended the throne; the people and all things are abundant and tranquil, customs are pure and admirable, the four border peoples all submit as guests, and the myriad regions rejoice in their occupations. Everything pertaining to the Way of bringing about order and protecting the state, of maintaining fullness and preserving the achievements of your predecessors, has reached the utmost perfection and completeness! Yet Your Majesty still embodies the Way with humble modesty, lets your mind roam toward lofty and far-reaching ideals, is keen in planning for governance, and is earnest in seeking counsel. In the leisure from the myriad affairs of state, Your Majesty has specially summoned your servants to the court and graciously bestowed Your pure inquiry, asking about the essentials of drawing upon both the civil and the military and the Way of regulating and completing Heaven and Earth. Yet your servant is a mere ordinary…

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
儒識見譾陋曷足以上揆
淵衷仰裨治道然竊思之臣荷
朝廷作養之恩沐
陛下化導之德有愛
君憂國之心無由以自獻有忠
君報國之志無路以自達今幸見錄於有司得立
玉階方寸地正叫
閶闔呈琅玕之日也敢不俯竭愚衷以對揚於萬一乎
臣聞民者所以固邦本而理民之任則在乎擇材於
文兵者所以衛民生而馭兵之寄則在乎拔功於武
===
故翕受敷施九德咸事而致庶績之其凝武夫洸洸
經營四方而致王心之載寧文臣武將自古為重誠
不可不審也我
國家崇儒重道取士之制雖非一途要之首科貢而次
薦舉未嘗不重文臣之選崇德報功選將之道亦非
一端要之先才能而後廕叙未嘗不重武將之職銓
衡之途奚至於壅衛所之員奚至於濫乎仰惟
陛下有迪知忱恂之明有庶政惟和之效然猶圖底丕平
以文臣武將為兵民之所賴故欲有以疏通之此尤
見

punctuated:
儒，識見譾陋，曷足以上揆淵衷，仰裨治道？然竊思之：臣荷朝廷作養之恩，沐陛下化導之德，有愛君憂國之心，無由以自獻；有忠君報國之志，無路以自達。今幸見錄於有司，得立玉階方寸地，正叫閶闔、呈琅玕之日也，敢不俯竭愚衷，以對揚於萬一乎！
臣聞：民者所以固邦本，而理民之任，則在乎擇材於文；兵者所以衛民生，而馭兵之寄，則在乎拔功於武。故「翕受敷施，九德咸事」，而致庶績之其凝；「武夫洸洸，經營四方」，而致王心之載寧。文臣武將，自古為重，誠不可不審也。我國家崇儒重道，取士之制雖非一途，要之首科貢而次薦舉，未嘗不重文臣之選；崇德報功，選將之道亦非一端，要之先才能而後廕叙，未嘗不重武將之職。銓衡之途奚至於壅？衛所之員奚至於濫乎？仰惟陛下有迪知忱恂之明，有庶政惟和之效，然猶圖底丕平，以文臣武將為兵民之所賴，故欲有以疏通之，此尤見…
translation_en:
… scholar of shallow knowledge and narrow views, how could I be worthy to fathom Your profound thoughts above or to aid the way of governance? Yet when I reflect in private: Your servant has received the Imperial Court's grace of nurturing and cultivation, and has been bathed in Your Majesty's virtue of transformation and guidance. Having a heart that loves my Sovereign and worries for the state, I previously had no means to offer it; having an aspiration to be loyal to my Sovereign and repay the state, I had no path to make it reach You. Now, fortunately selected by the authorities, I am able to stand upon a square inch of ground at the jade steps. This is truly the day to call out at the palace gates and present my jade-like words; how could I dare not bow and exhaust my humble thoughts in order to respond to and extol even one ten-thousandth of Your inquiry!

Your servant has heard that the people are the means by which the foundation of the state is secured, and the responsibility of governing the people lies in selecting talent from among the civil; soldiers are the means by which the livelihood of the people is defended, and the charge of commanding soldiers lies in promoting merit from among the military. Therefore, when one "receives all and deploys them widely, so that those of the nine virtues all serve," it brings about the consolidation of all achievements; when "martial men are valorous, ordering the four quarters," it brings peace to the King's heart. Civil officials and military commanders have been esteemed since antiquity, and their selection truly cannot go unexamined. Our dynasty reveres Confucianism and honors the Way. Although the system for selecting scholars is not limited to a single path, in essence it puts the examinations and tribute students first and recommendations second—never failing to attach importance to the selection of civil officials. It reveres virtue and rewards merit. Although the way of choosing commanders is likewise not confined to a single method, in essence it puts ability and talent first and hereditary privilege second—never failing to attach importance to the offices of military commanders. Why, then, has the path of personnel selection and evaluation come to be congested, and why has the personnel of the Guards and Battalions come to be excessive? Looking up, I reflect that Your Majesty possesses the clarity of enlightened knowledge and sincere trustworthiness, and achieves the effect of harmony in all affairs of government; yet You still seek to attain great peace, regarding civil officials and military commanders as those upon whom soldiers and the people rely, and therefore wish to find a way to clear and open up their paths. In this is especially seen …

title: 成化五年進士登科錄
text:
聖智之高明也臣請得為
陛下言之盖自邇年以来文臣則或因開貢之條而混升
國學或緣納粟之例而濫登仕籍况夫拘於資格之
先後牽於歷任之久近以有限之職待雜進之流銓
衡之途由之壅矣武將則勲舊是屬而秉節鉞者或
韜畧之蔑聞弊習相承而統師旅者或勤能之罕著
况夫功多出於賄求賞每加於倖得未經鋒鏑之勞
巳登録用之典衛所之員由之濫矣銓衡之途既壅何
敢望其展素蘊以理民衛所之員既濫何敢望其奮
武勇以馭兵哉此不能無勞於
===
聖慮也為今之計莫若嚴考察黜陟之法治行卓異者則
增秩以獎異之年力衰邁者則以禮而退遣之杜塞
奔競僥倖之門擯斥庸陋貪汚之輩則用人之道必
如唐臣陸贄所謂名利相均而不至於壅矣重爵賞
勸懲之典功勲既著者則計其勞以加賞材畧有聞
者則隨其能以授任不以其無功而施汎濫之恩不
以其有罪而行姑息之政則選將之要必如唐臣陸
贄所謂虚實相濟而不至於濫矣盖誘人之方惟名
與利名近虚而於教為重利近實而於德為輕錫貨
財賦秩廩所以彰其實差品列殊章服所以飾其虚
